title: BlackRock Inc. Acquires Additional Shares in Mercury Systems Inc.
summary: BlackRock Inc. has increased its stake in Mercury Systems Inc. by acquiring an additional 100,009 shares, bringing its total holdings to 5,878,104 shares. This transaction highlights BlackRock's confidence in the aerospace and defense company, which is considered undervalued by GuruFocus's GF Valuation despite recent stock declines. Mercury Systems Inc. demonstrates good outperformance potential with a strong GF Score, profitability, and growth rank, but also presents some financial risks.

title: Genpact incorporates gen AI into its Enterprise360 platform
summary: Genpact has integrated generative AI capabilities into its Enterprise360 intelligence platform, a tool used globally by clients to manage and revamp operations. This integration empowers clients to generate innovative solutions for operational challenges, enhance decision-making, and accelerate value delivery. The platform, which aids in digitizing operational rituals and provides insights from numerous metrics, aims to drive greater performance and transformation for its clients.

title: Microsoft named a Leader and Positioned Furthest for Completeness of Vision in the 2023 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Robotic Process Automation
summary: For the third consecutive year, Microsoft has been recognized as a Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Robotic Process Automation (RPA), achieving the furthest position for Completeness of Vision in 2023. This recognition is attributed to continuous innovation in Power Automate, driven by community engagement, customer feedback, partner contributions, and developer input. Key advancements include the integration of generative AI with Copilot, custom UI actions for Power Automate for desktop, expanded cloud API connectors, and the general availability of hosted RPA.

title: Video Game M&A Surges In Q2 2023 With Big-Name Mobile Deals
summary: Video game M&A activity saw a surprising surge in Q2 2023, reaching $5.99 billion in gross transaction value, the highest since Q1 2022. This increase was driven primarily by mobile gaming deals outside the US, despite the ongoing legal battle surrounding Microsoft's acquisition of Activision Blizzard. Notable transactions included Savvy Games Group's $4.90 billion acquisition of Scopely and Sega Sammy Holdings' $781.8 million deal for Rovio Entertainment.

title: Verizon to ‘sunset’ Blue Jeans vidconf platform
summary: Verizon is discontinuing its BlueJeans video collaboration platform, which it acquired in April 2020. The company cited "changing market conditions in a post-pandemic landscape" as the reason, shifting its focus to other priorities like 5G and mobile edge computing. The move highlights the intense competition in the video conferencing market and the impact of evolving work trends.

title: AWS and Five9 Become Leaders in 2023’s Gartner CCaaS Magic Quadrant
summary: Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Five9 have achieved leader status in Gartner's 2023 CCaaS Magic Quadrant, driven by their significant investments in innovation and market expansion respectively. AWS was recognized for its agile pricing and extensive partner network, while Five9's enterprise deployment growth and AI competency were key factors. Conversely, Talkdesk dropped out of the leader quadrant due to sales and service operation cautions outside of Europe and the US, despite its continued growth.

title: 9 customer journey mapping tools that can improve your CX
summary: This article explores nine customer journey mapping tools that can help companies improve their customer experience (CX) by analyzing customer paths across various channels. It discusses key features to consider when choosing a tool, such as ease of use, flexibility, collaboration, and integration capabilities. The article also provides a list of specific tools, ranging from simple diagramming software to comprehensive customer experience platforms.

title: Mark your calendars: GTA 6 seemingly set for late 2024 or early 2025
summary: Take-Two Interactive's recent financial reports suggest a potential release window for Grand Theft Auto 6 between late 2024 and early 2025. The publisher expects a significant jump in Net Bookings for fiscal year 2025, which industry analysts attribute to the anticipated launch of GTA 6. This aligns with earlier leaks about the game's setting and multiple playable protagonists.

title: Is Zoom using your meetings to train its AI?
summary: Zoom faced a privacy backlash after an updated terms of service (TOS) suggested it might use customer data from meetings to train its AI models. Although Zoom clarified it would not use audio, video, or chat content for AI training without consent, the initial wording caused alarm given Zoom's history of privacy missteps. The incident highlights broader public concerns about how companies use customer data to develop AI technologies.

title: Capital Research Global Investors Acquires Significant Stake in Carrier Global Corp
summary: Capital Research Global Investors acquired over 9 million additional shares of Carrier Global Corp. on July 31, 2023, increasing their total holdings to more than 86 million shares, representing 10.30% of Carrier Global Corp.'s total shares. This significant transaction, valued at $59.55 per share, underscores Capital Research Global Investors' continued investment in the industrial company despite Carrier Global Corp. being considered modestly overvalued by GuruFocus. The investment firm, with substantial holdings in technology and healthcare, now holds a considerable stake in the HVAC and security products manufacturer.

title: Cloud as the ultimate digital enabler
summary: This interview with Elevance Health's CTO discusses their transformative cloud journey, highlighting lessons learned, drivers, benefits, and operating model evolution. They emphasize the importance of a systematic migration approach, agile methodologies, and cross-functional collaboration to maximize value from cloud adoption. The company achieved significant cost savings and enhanced member experiences by leveraging cloud-native capabilities and a product mindset.

title: Microsoft Azure meets growing needs of healthcare organizations, such as Mount Sinai Health System, with a highly scalable public cloud for Epic
summary: Microsoft announced that Epic clients, including Mount Sinai Health System, can now utilize Microsoft Azure Large Instances to run large Epic electronic health record (EHR) databases in the public cloud. This solution offers high scalability and dedicated resources, enabling healthcare organizations to manage significant database loads. The move aims to facilitate digital transformation, accelerate AI adoption, improve operational efficiency, and reduce infrastructure costs for healthcare providers.

title: TDVI Top Holdings List & Exposure (FT Vest Technology Dividend Target Income ETF)
summary: This article details the top holdings and exposure of the FT Vest Technology Dividend Target Income ETF (TDVI). It provides a ranked list of the ETF's top 25 stock holdings, including companies like Broadcom, Texas Instruments, and Oracle, which collectively make up over 80% of the fund. The article also breaks down TDVI's geographic, currency, sector, and industry exposure, highlighting its focus on U.S. technology companies and semiconductors.

title: Unlocking the potential of AI for the energy industry
summary: Artificial intelligence is transforming the energy industry by enhancing safety, accelerating subsurface characterization, and promoting sustainability through autonomous operations. To fully realize its potential, the industry must adopt open and secure data platforms, embrace rapid experimentation, integrate new technologies, and develop an AI-trained workforce. SLB is addressing these needs through open data initiatives, accessible AI tools, specialized innovation centers, and a "Domain Data Scientist" training program.

title: Artificial Intelligence at Morgan Stanley – Three Use Cases
summary: Morgan Stanley utilizes AI across three key areas to enhance its financial services: internal-facing chatbots for financial advisors, personalized client communication through recommendation systems, and an impact analysis tool for sustainable investing. The firm has partnered with OpenAI for its GPT-4-powered chatbot to drive efficiency and scale, while also leveraging machine learning for its Next Best Action system and the Morgan Stanley IQ® tool to align client portfolios with impact preferences. These AI initiatives aim to improve advisor efficiency, client engagement, and retention by providing tailored insights and investment options.

title: Amazon is removed from key list of climate-conscious companies
summary: Amazon has been removed from the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) list of companies taking action on climate goals due to its failure to set a credible target for reducing carbon emissions. This decision comes despite Amazon's 2019 pledge to eliminate or offset all carbon emissions by 2040 and a subsequent retraction of a 2030 zero-carbon delivery target. The removal raises questions about Amazon's standing among ESG investment funds, as its emissions have increased by 40% since 2019.

title: Dropbox review: Still the best at syncing and sharing
summary: This PCWorld review reaffirms Dropbox's position as a top choice for fast, reliable file synchronization and sharing, despite its limited free storage and lack of intermediate subscription tiers. While it excels in its core functionality and offers business-oriented features, its pricing model lacks options between the free 2GB and the paid 2TB. The article highlights its strengths for collaborative file access and its backup capabilities.

title: ERISA Case Against Cisco Over BlackRock TDFs Dismissed
summary: A federal court in California dismissed a breach of fiduciary duty lawsuit against Cisco Systems under ERISA, concerning its selection of BlackRock's LifePath target-date funds (TDFs). The judge ruled that underperformance alone over a short period does not constitute imprudence, especially without evidence of a flawed selection process. This dismissal is one of several similar cases brought by Miller Shah against various companies, all of which have been rejected on similar grounds.

title: UPDATE: San Jose delays decision on city-run power grid
summary: The San Jose City Council has unanimously voted to delay a decision on establishing a city-run power utility, "San Jose Power," until October 3. This deferral allows officials more time to analyze the complex financial and operational implications of creating such a utility, which aims to capitalize on new high-voltage transmission lines. The proposed utility is intended to serve key infrastructure sites and attract new businesses, potentially offering significant cost savings on electricity.

title: Intel’s Terminated $5.4B Tower Acquisition: 5 Big Things To Know
summary: Intel terminated its $5.4 billion acquisition of Tower Semiconductor due to regulatory approval issues, a setback for CEO Pat Gelsinger's IDM 2.0 strategy and Intel Foundry Services. The deal's failure, possibly due to U.S.-China geopolitical tensions, resulted in a $353 million termination fee. Despite this, Intel remains committed to its foundry business, aiming to become the second-largest global external foundry by 2030, though Tower's capacity and customer base would have provided a significant boost.

title: American Airlines Group – Digital Transformation Strategies
summary: American Airlines is heavily investing in digital transformation, with an estimated ICT spending of $1.7 billion for 2023, primarily focused on software and hardware. The company is leveraging disruptive technologies like AI, big data, blockchain, and cloud to enhance operations and improve customer service, as demonstrated by its use of a machine learning engine to optimize gate assignments. This strategy aims to improve efficiency and maintain a competitive edge in the travel industry.

title: Accelerate Insurance Claims Digital Transformation with Low-Code Platforms
summary: Leading insurers are increasingly adopting low-code platforms to accelerate development cycles for claims systems, moving from years to months. These platforms address challenges like evolving consumer digital expectations, workforce changes, and rising costs by enabling faster application development with minimal coding. Low-code solutions offer versatility for extending core systems without disruption, empowering insurers to create more personalized and efficient claims experiences.

title: Roblox faces a new class action lawsuit alleging it facilitates child gambling
summary: Roblox is facing a new class action lawsuit accusing it of facilitating child gambling through third-party sites using its in-game currency, Robux. Parents claim their children have lost thousands of Robux on these sites, which offer games like blackjack and roulette. Roblox denies affiliation with these sites but states it has teams investigating and may pursue action against them, while also acknowledging that its community standards prohibit simulated gambling.

title: The Next Big Things From SAP
summary: SAP recently unveiled significant innovations at its Sapphire event in Orlando, focusing on responsible AI integrated into business solutions, ledger-based accounting for carbon tracking (green ledger initiative), and industry-specific networks to enhance supply-chain resilience. These advancements aim to help customers transform their business models in the cloud, prioritize sustainability, and boost agility in an evolving future. SAP is also expanding partnerships, like with Google Cloud for open data, and committing to upskill two million people globally to meet the demand for SAP experts.

title: Markets News, Aug. 22, 2023: Tech Buoys Nasdaq; Nvidia, Banks Weigh on S&P 500
summary: U.S. markets closed mixed on August 22, 2023, with the Nasdaq Composite Index slightly up due to tech stocks, while the S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average declined. Financial stocks were hit by another downgrade from S&P, affecting several regional banks. Companies like Boeing, Apple, and Baidu saw gains, while Merck, Nike, and several retailers experienced drops.

title: Silicon Labs Unveils the Series 3 IoT Platform, Pledges 100x Performance Gains for On-Device ML, AI - Hackster.io
summary: Silicon Labs has announced its new "Series 3" Internet of Things (IoT) platform, claiming a 100-fold boost in performance for on-device machine learning and artificial intelligence workloads. The company also launched Simplicity Studio 6 with decoupled development tools and new chips for Amazon Sidewalk devices.

title: Boeing Recognizes 2023 Supplier of the Year Award Winners
summary: Boeing recognized 12 of its top-performing global suppliers at its 2023 Supplier of the Year event in Orlando. These suppliers were celebrated for their contributions to Boeing's safety, quality, sustainability, and delivery commitments amidst a challenging environment. The awards encompassed various categories including Outstanding Performance, Collaboration, Sustainability, and more, highlighting the crucial role suppliers play in Boeing's operations.

title: The best ETFs for retirement income
summary: This article explores the best ETFs for retirement income, focusing on conservative asset allocation ETFs and tactical overlays for retirees. title: Yamaha’s CS-500 Now Certified for Microsoft Teams, Adding to Yamaha’s Portfolio of Certified Video Sound Collaboration Systems
summary: Yamaha has announced that its CS-500 Video Collaboration System is now Certified for Microsoft Teams, expanding its portfolio of certified video sound collaboration products. The CS-500 integrates a microphone and camera into a single device, featuring SoundCap Eye™ technology for focused audio capture and a 4K AI-enabled video camera with auto-framing. This certification ensures a seamless conferencing experience for Microsoft Teams in various meeting room sizes, similar to its predecessor, the CS-800.

title: Microsoft’s Python in Excel: A fusion enabling optimal data analysis and visualization
summary: Microsoft is integrating Python into Excel, allowing users to leverage Python's powerful data analysis capabilities directly within their spreadsheets. This feature, called Python in Excel, is available as a public preview for Microsoft 365 Insiders on Windows and includes access to popular Python libraries through a partnership with Anaconda. It aims to streamline data science workflows by enabling seamless execution of Python code within Excel, eliminating the need to switch between applications.

summary: MicroStrategy has announced the availability of its MicroStrategy ONE platform in the Microsoft Azure Marketplace. This integration allows Azure customers to deploy MicroStrategy ONE, leveraging Azure's cloud platform for streamlined deployment and management. The platform offers AI-driven analytics capabilities, including natural language features and productivity enhancements, enabling faster, more informed decision-making for businesses.

title: NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for Second Quarter Fiscal 2024
summary: NVIDIA reported record revenue of $13.51 billion for the second quarter of fiscal 2024, a 101% increase from a year ago, driven by strong growth in Data Center revenue at $10.32 billion. The company also announced a new $25.00 billion share repurchase authorization and provided a positive outlook for the third quarter, expecting revenue of $16.00 billion. summary: TAL Education Group has launched the public beta of MathGPT, an innovative mathematical large model designed for global mathematics enthusiasts and research institutions. This LLM is China's first large model tailored for mathematics, offering problem-solving algorithms and explanations for problems ranging from elementary to high school levels. summary: YieldMax has introduced two new active ETFs, the YieldMax MSFT Option Income Strategy ETF (MSFO) and the YieldMax DIS Option Income Strategy ETF (DISO), designed to generate monthly income through a synthetic covered call strategy on Microsoft and Disney stocks, respectively. summary: Procter & Gamble is leveraging IoT and predictive analytics, specifically Microsoft's IoT and edge analytics platform, to enhance the production of Pampers diapers. summary: This article provides a detailed overview of the iShares Russell 1000 ETF (IWB), including its current stock price, key statistics like PE and PB ratios, and dividend yield. summary: New data reveals that young investors are increasingly willing to sacrifice investment returns to align their portfolios with environmental, social, and governance (ESG) causes they care about. title: How Yahoo sparked a renaissance under new owners
summary: Yahoo, under its new owner Apollo Global Management, is undergoing a significant revitalization, marked by strategic acquisitions to bolster its core products. The company, once considered a declining asset, is leveraging its still profitable legacy entities and strong traffic numbers to reinvent itself in various market segments. title: Is Domo Stock a Buy Now?
summary: Domo's stock recently plunged 36% after its Q2 fiscal 2024 earnings report, despite narrower-than-expected losses and revenue slightly beating estimates. The cloud-based software company's growth has stalled due to macro headwinds, stiff competition from tech giants like Salesforce and Microsoft, and a shift to consumption-based pricing. summary: HCA Healthcare is expanding its partnership with Google Cloud and Augmedix to deploy generative AI tools in emergency departments, aiming to improve documentation efficiency and allow clinicians more time for patient care. Following a successful pilot program in four hospitals, HCA is considering wider implementation of Google's generative AI, and also exploring the use of Google's medical large language model, Med-PaLM 2, for complex medical queries. The initiative focuses on enhancing workflows and caregiver support while acknowledging the need for careful ethical deployment and rigorous quality assessment of AI in healthcare.

title: GM, Google exploring ways to use AI across automaker’s business
summary: General Motors and Google are expanding their partnership to explore the integration of AI technologies across GM's business operations. This collaboration builds on their previous work on GM's OnStar Interactive Virtual Assistant, aiming to revolutionize the automotive experience through generative AI. The companies anticipate AI will enhance vehicle validation, software, and in-car assistance, with potential future applications including customer interaction and new features.

title: A Roadmap for Selecting the Right CCaaS Vendor
summary: This article provides a roadmap for selecting a Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) vendor, driven by the increasing adoption of CCaaS platforms for their flexibility and scalability. title: How space traffic in orbit could spell trouble on Earth
summary: The increasing number of satellites in Earth's orbit, particularly large constellations like Starlink, significantly raises the risk of catastrophic collisions and the generation of more space debris. Such collisions could disrupt vital services on Earth, including GPS, communication, weather forecasting, and intelligence gathering. The current patchwork of international regulations is insufficient to manage this growing traffic, highlighting the urgent need for a formal, coordinated global system to prevent disasters and maintain the functionality of orbital infrastructure.

title: Leveraging Generative AI to Build Personalized Customer Journey Mapping
summary: This report details how marketing teams are utilizing Generative AI (GenAI) for customer personalization and workflow improvements. Based on a survey of 100 marketing professionals, it highlights GenAI's role in content creation, personalization, and the use of synthetic data, while also addressing its integration with existing marketing automation platforms. The findings indicate widespread adoption and positive impacts on efficiency, suggesting GenAI is a valuable, though not always central, tool for future customer journey mapping.

title: Salesforce lifts annual forecast as business software demand stays strong
summary: Salesforce raised its annual revenue forecast and projected quarterly sales above estimates, benefiting from recent price hikes and strong demand for its cloud and business software. The company's shares rose, signaling optimism about a recovery in technology spending and its new AI integrations. Salesforce also increased its full-year adjusted operating margin forecast, bolstered by its first price hike in seven years.

title: Oxygen Top 45 ‘must-know’ UK IT Distributors
summary: IT Channel Oxygen has released its inaugural list of the top 45 "must-know" UK IT distributors, highlighting companies ranging from broadline giants like Westcoast and Ingram Micro to niche start-up VADs. These 45 distributors collectively generate over £14 billion in revenue, showing significant growth year-on-year despite challenges such as shrinking hardware sales and declining average selling prices. The report delves into market trends, M&A activity, and the shifting dynamics of the UK IT distribution landscape, including the surge in cloud and cybersecurity segments.

title: Enel Generación y Enel X sellan acuerdo con cruzados como “Partner Energético” del nuevo estadio de la UC
summary: Enel Generación and Enel X have partnered with Cruzados to make Universidad Católica's new stadium the first 100% sustainable sports venue in Chile. The agreement includes supplying 100% renewable energy for six years, implementing a solar autogeneration plant, and adding electric vehicle charging infrastructure. This initiative aims to significantly reduce CO2 emissions and serves as a model for future sustainable constructions in Chile.

title: Worker confidence in AI may be growing despite unease about the tech
summary: A Robert Half survey indicates growing worker confidence in generative AI, with 4 in 10 U.S. workers believing it will positively impact their careers, despite past unease regarding job displacement. The survey, conducted in May 2023, shows HR and tech professionals, along with younger generations, are particularly optimistic about AI's ability to automate tasks and increase efficiency. Companies are increasingly adopting AI for various functions, leading to a surge in demand for AI-related skills.

title: IXN: Not A True Global Tech Play
summary: The iShares Global Tech ETF (IXN) is criticized for its misleading name, as it is heavily concentrated in U.S.-based tech giants like Apple, Microsoft, and Nvidia, comprising nearly two-thirds of its portfolio. Despite its "global" designation, over 80% of its holdings are U.S. companies, limiting true international exposure and sector diversification. This article highlights that IXN is not a genuinely global technology investment, potentially making investors vulnerable if they seek diversified international tech exposure.

title: SAP nabs new global AI head from Microsoft, Walter Sun
summary: SAP has appointed Walter Sun, formerly VP of Copilot Applied Artificial Intelligence at Microsoft, as its new global head of AI. This strategic hire underscores SAP's commitment to prioritizing AI, following recent collaborations with Microsoft and Google Cloud to integrate generative AI into its enterprise offerings. Sun, with his extensive background in AI and machine learning, is tasked with leveraging SAP's broad applications and customer base to transform business operations through innovative AI solutions.

title: Which companies are the best employers in Kentucky? UK and Norton top the Forbes list
summary: Forbes has released its fifth annual list of the best employers in Kentucky for 2023, based on employee surveys. The University of Kentucky topped the list, with several Louisville-based companies like Norton Healthcare, Baptist Health, and Humana also making it into the top 10. The ranking considered aspects such as working conditions, diversity, and company image.

title: HPE storage comes with full IT stack, hybrid cloud and as a service
summary: This article examines Hewlett Packard Enterprise's (HPE) strategy to position itself as a comprehensive IT stack provider, moving beyond just storage. It details HPE's Greenlake consumption model, which offers as-a-service options across on-prem and hybrid cloud environments, particularly highlighting the revamped Alletra MP storage line. The piece covers HPE's origins, market ranking, key storage products, and its approach to cloud, containerization, and various consumption models.

title: Bill Gates buys stake in Anheuser-Busch InBev
summary: Bill Gates, through the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation Trust, has invested nearly $96.6 million in Anheuser-Busch InBev, acquiring 1.7 million shares. This investment comes as AB InBev's share price has dropped due to a boycott of its Bud Light brand following a controversial marketing campaign. Gates had previously invested in Heineken earlier the same year.

title: Bandwidth Partners with Google and Cognigy to Launch AIBridge, Integrating Artificial Intelligence with Contact Centers Using Maestro
summary: Bandwidth has announced a partnership with Google and Cognigy to launch AIBridge, a new capability within its Maestro platform. AIBridge enables enterprises to deploy voice-based AI tools to their contact centers, allowing for faster and more efficient call resolution in the communications cloud without direct agent intervention. This integration is designed to improve customer experience, increase agent satisfaction, and significantly reduce contact center operating costs by leveraging conversational AI from partners like Cognigy.AI and Google Cloud's Dialogflow.

title: Will GTA 6 cost $150? Probably not, but how much would you pay?
summary: A rumor circulating on social media suggests that Grand Theft Auto 6 could debut at a staggering $150 for the base game. While this price is highly improbable, the article discusses the rising cost of AAA video games, with many now starting at $69.99, and speculates on what players would be willing to pay for the highly anticipated title. Rockstar's success with GTA V and GTA Online allows for significant investment in GTA 6's development, and the game is expected to be a major financial success.

title: Bristol Myers Squibb Tech and Digital Chief Develops A Game Plan For Generative AI
summary: Greg Meyers, Chief Digital & Technology Officer of Bristol Myers Squibb (BMS), outlines his strategy for integrating generative AI into the company's operations after personally exploring ChatGPT 3.5. summary: Qualcomm Technologies has expanded its Snapdragon Digital Chassis portfolio with new QWM2290 and QWS2290 platforms designed for ICE and electric two-wheelers, micro-mobility, and other motorized vehicles. summary: Blackstone, the world's largest alternative-asset manager, has aggressively integrated artificial intelligence into its operations thanks to a directive from CEO Stephen Schwarzman. summary: HubSpot's INBOUND 2023 conference unveiled a significant strategic shift towards generative AI tools and data analytics, introducing HubSpot AI, a new suite of generative AI features including AI Assistants and AI Insights for predictive analytics. summary: Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon believes artificial intelligence could spark a new upgrade cycle for smartphones, revitalizing a market that saw a significant sales decline in 2022. title: South Korean mobility platform introduces AI-based revamp
summary: Tmap Mobility, a South Korea-based platform, has launched an AI-powered navigation app that integrates and personalizes various mobility services. The revamped TMAP now combines driver-oriented features like route guidance and EV charging locations with public transportation options, including a new airport bus service and soon, shared bicycles. This new iteration also expands into lifestyle services, offering restaurant, hotel, and attraction reservations through its AI-based personalization.

summary: McKinsey and Salesforce have announced a new collaboration to accelerate the introduction of trusted generative AI for sales, marketing, commerce, and service. summary: Rackspace Technology has appointed Reema Aggarwal as Country Head, Public Cloud for India, based in Bengaluru. summary: A Microsoft internal investigation revealed that a consumer signing key, used by a China-based threat group to compromise U.S. cabinet email accounts, was exposed in an April 2021 crash dump. title: Building safe, secure and trustworthy AI: Adobe’s commitments to our customers and community
summary: Adobe outlines its commitment to safe, secure, and trustworthy AI development, aligning with the White House Voluntary AI Commitments. The company emphasizes rigorous testing, security measures, and the development of Content Credentials to enhance transparency and combat misinformation in AI-generated content. Furthermore, Adobe pledges to empower creators by enabling "Do Not Train" tags and advocating for federal anti-impersonation rights to protect artists in the AI era.

title: New Coder 2.0 aims to elevate onboarding and productivity in the cloud era
summary: Coder Technologies Inc. announced the general availability of Coder 2.0, an open-source, cloud-native platform designed to enhance developer onboarding and productivity by shifting development to cloud-based workspaces. The new version introduces Dev Container support, a template registry, and integration with JFrog Artifactory and Xray, aiming to provide a local development experience with the security, power, and scalability of the cloud. Coder 2.0 seeks to streamline CDE workflows and remove productivity bottlenecks for developers and platform engineering teams.

title: Microsoft recognized as a Leader in 2023 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Desktop as a Service
summary: Microsoft has been recognized as a Leader in the inaugural 2023 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Desktop as a Service (DaaS), highlighting its commitment to providing secure and versatile cloud solutions for flexible work. The article discusses Microsoft's key DaaS offerings, Windows 365 and Azure Virtual Desktop, and recent innovations such as Windows 365 Frontline and enhanced security features like watermarking and confidential virtual machines in Azure Virtual Desktop. This recognition reinforces Microsoft's focus on empowering productivity for all employees through modern endpoint solutions.

title: Constellation Inks Deal with Major U.S. Utility for 100 Percent Hourly Carbon-Free Energy Matching
summary: Constellation announced an agreement with Commonwealth Edison (ComEd) to power all 54 of ComEd's facilities with 100 percent hourly carbon-free nuclear energy. This makes ComEd the first investor-owned utility to achieve this advanced level of clean energy matching. The deal, similar to one with Microsoft, sets a new standard for emissions reduction by ensuring that clean energy is produced where and when it is consumed, addressing the limitations of traditional annual renewable energy certificates.

title: Cloud Security Posture Management Market Size Set for Rapid Growth with a Projected CAGR of 10.8% to Achieve Market Valuation of USD 12.6 Billion by 2032
summary: The Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) Market is predicted to reach USD 12.6 billion by 2032, growing at a CAGR of 10.8% from USD 4.6 billion in 2022. This growth is driven by the increasing adoption of cloud services, evolving cyber threats, and stringent data regulations. North America currently leads the market, benefiting from early cloud adoption and robust data regulations.

title: Microsoft expands partnership with Oracle to bring customers’ mission-critical database workloads to Azure
summary: Microsoft and Oracle are expanding their partnership to enable Oracle's customers to run mission-critical database workloads on Microsoft Azure. This new offering, Oracle Database@Azure, allows customers to migrate existing Oracle databases "as is" to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and deploy them within Azure datacenters, providing seamless integration with Azure services like Azure OpenAI. The collaboration aims to reduce hurdles for cloud migration and allow businesses to leverage cutting-edge cloud services with their Oracle databases, improving efficiency and enabling new applications.

title: Microsoft and Oracle Expand Partnership to Deliver Oracle Database Services on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure in Microsoft Azure
summary: Microsoft and Oracle have expanded their partnership to launch Oracle Database@Azure, allowing customers direct access to Oracle database services running on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) in Microsoft Azure datacenters. This collaboration simplifies cloud migration, offers high-performance Oracle databases with Azure's services and AI capabilities, and provides a streamlined purchasing process through Azure Marketplace. The service aims to address challenges in multicloud architectures and is supported by a joint support model.

title: Microsoft and Oracle expand partnership to deliver Oracle Database Services on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure in Microsoft Azure
summary: Microsoft and Oracle announced Oracle Database@Azure, providing direct access to Oracle database services running on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) deployed in Microsoft Azure datacenters. This expanded partnership aims to simplify cloud migration and multicloud deployment for customers, offering enhanced performance, security, and integration with Azure's AI services. Customers will benefit from a streamlined operating environment, simplified purchasing through Azure Marketplace, and joint support for critical workloads.

title: 3 investors from Microsoft’s corporate VC arm M12 are striking out on their own with a new AI-focused firm
summary: Three former investors from Microsoft's corporate venture capital arm, M12 – Nagraj Kashyap, Priya Saiprasad, and Samir Kumar – are launching a new AI-focused venture capital firm called Touring Capital. The firm will focus on Series B and C stage software-as-a-service companies powered by AI, with a strategy to "tour" the world for investment opportunities outside of Silicon Valley. They are currently raising their first fund, targeting $300 million, and have already made their first investment in Pixis.

title: Constellation, ComEd in landmark energy-matching deal
summary: Constellation and ComEd have announced a landmark hourly carbon-free energy matching agreement, making ComEd the first investor-owned US utility to power all its facilities with locally produced nuclear energy from the time and place it is consumed. This initiative aims to genuinely achieve zero carbon emissions by matching clean energy production with consumption, a method Constellation touts as crucial for meeting 2050 climate goals. ComEd will match its anticipated 65,000 MWh electricity use across its 54 facilities with this method, which differs from traditional annual renewable energy certificates.

title: Invesco MSCI USA ETF (PBUS) Stock Price, Holdings, Dividend Yield
summary: This article provides a detailed overview of the Invesco MSCI USA ETF (PBUS), including its current stock price, key statistics like PE Ratio and Dividend Yield, and its top holdings as of August 31, 2025. The ETF has a portfolio value of $8.44 billion with top holdings including NVIDIA, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, and Meta Platforms. It also presents historical performance data and breakdowns of asset allocation and sector exposure.

title: Infosys Only Indian Firm On TIME World's 100 Best Companies List
summary: Infosys is the only Indian company to be featured in the top 100 of TIME Magazine and Statista's World's Best Companies of 2023 list, securing the 64th spot. The ranking, which included 750 companies, was based on revenue growth, employee satisfaction, and ESG data. Seven other Indian companies, including Wipro, Reliance Industries, and HDFC Bank, also made it to the broader list.

title: Goldman Sachs Physical Gold ETF ETF Price, Holdings, & News (CBOE:AAAU)
summary: The Goldman Sachs Physical Gold ETF (AAAU) tracks the LBMA Gold Price index, investing in physical gold bars held in Perth, Australia. It offers investors exposure to gold spot prices, with shares redeemable for gold coins and small bars. AAAU was launched on July 26, 2018, and has seen its shares increase by 65.1% this year, trading at $42.82.

title: Infosys only Indian company in top 100 TIME World's Best Companies list
summary: Infosys is the sole Indian company to secure a spot in the top 100 of TIME Magazine and Statista's World's Best Companies of 2023 list, ranking 64th. The list evaluates companies based on revenue growth, employee satisfaction, and ESG data. While other Indian companies like Wipro, Mahindra Group, and Reliance Industries were present in the larger list of 750, Infosys stood out for its high growth rate and position among top professional services firms.

title: In Silico Part - IV : AI and its impact on labor, productivity, and tech-driven deflation
summary: This article examines the uncertain macroeconomic impacts of Artificial Intelligence, focusing on its potential effects on labor, productivity, and deflation. It discusses AI's role in creative destruction, its likelihood of augmenting rather than fully replacing human labor in the near term, and its historical and future contributions to productivity growth and deflationary pressures. The authors conclude that AI is anticipated to boost productivity and exert deflationary forces, while acknowledging that long-term labor displacement is possible, leading to the creation of new job categories.

title: Publishers’ Lawsuit Accuses Libgen of “Staggering” Copyright Infringement
summary: Major publishers including Cengage, Macmillan Learning, McGraw Hill, and Pearson Education have filed a copyright infringement lawsuit against Library Genesis (Libgen), a prominent "shadow library," in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York. The lawsuit claims "staggering" levels of infringement, with over six million files on Libgen infringing copyrights, and seeks damages, an injunction, and control over Libgen's domains. Publishers argue that Libgen's operations cause significant financial and creative harm, undermining the publishing industry and authors' income, despite the site's claim of providing free access to educational literature.

title: Sanofi uses the industrial metaverse to revolutionize training and operational efficiency
summary: Sanofi has implemented a pilot project using Microsoft HoloLens 2 with Dynamics 365 Guides and Remote Assist to revolutionize employee training and operational efficiency in its packaging workshop. This initiative has reduced training time for new operators from eight to six weeks, standardized training procedures, and enhanced troubleshooting capabilities through remote assistance. Sanofi plans to expand this solution across its value chain, leveraging the industrial metaverse for greater efficiency and innovation.

title: JPMorgan Global Select Equity ETF ETF Price, Holdings, & News (NASDAQ:JGLO) $JGLO
summary: This article provides details on the JPMorgan Global Select Equity ETF (JGLO), including its current price, holdings, and recent news. The ETF aims for long-term capital appreciation by investing in global equities across various market capitalizations, integrating ESG factors. Key statistics, expense ratios, major shareholders, and top holdings like NVIDIA and Microsoft are highlighted.

title: JGLO Top Holdings List & Exposure (JPMorgan Global Select Equity ETF)
summary: This article details the top holdings and exposure of the JPMorgan Global Select Equity ETF (JGLO). NVIDIA, Amazon.com, and Microsoft are among its largest holdings, making up a significant portion of the fund. The ETF primarily invests in large-cap companies globally, with a strong concentration in the United States and the Technology sector.

title: 29 African Startups in Healthcare Supply Chain Selected to Receive Funding and Impact Support from the Gates Foundation, MSD, and More
summary: The Investing in Innovation (i3) program, funded by the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation and sponsored by Cencora, MSD, Microsoft, and Chemonics, has selected 29 African startups for its second cohort. These startups, operating in 21 African countries, will receive a $50,000 grant, market access, and tailored investment readiness support to enhance healthcare supply chains. The program aims to foster growth-focused partnerships and drive the commercialization of innovative solutions, building on the success of its first cohort which secured 24 contracts and strategic partnerships.

title: Morgan Stanley kicks off generative AI era on Wall Street with assistant for financial advisors
summary: Morgan Stanley is launching its AI @ Morgan Stanley Assistant, created with OpenAI's GPT-4, for all financial advisors and their support staff. This tool provides speedy access to a 100,000-document database, aiming to improve client interactions and efficiency by freeing up advisors' time. It marks the first major Wall Street firm to deploy such a bespoke generative AI solution for employees.

title: Morgan Stanley to Launch AI-Powered Assistant for Financial Advisers
summary: Morgan Stanley is launching an AI-powered assistant for its financial advisers and support staff, named the AI @ Morgan Stanley Assistant. This tool, based on OpenAI's GPT-4, provides quick access to 100,000 research reports and documents, aiming to enhance client interactions and efficiency. The bank also plans to introduce other generative AI tools, including "Debrief" for summarizing meetings and generating follow-up emails.

title: iShares MSCI ACWI ETF
summary: The iShares MSCI ACWI ETF (ACWI) offers investors global equity exposure to large and mid-capitalization developed and emerging markets. It tracks the MSCI All Country World Index, providing diversification across numerous countries and sectors efficiently. The ETF is marketed as a low-cost investment vehicle with potential for long-term growth, though it acknowledges inherent investment risks.

title: Intel pitches the 'AI PC' at software developer event
summary: Intel announced a new "Meteor Lake" chip, expected in December, that will enable generative AI chatbots to run directly on laptops without needing cloud data centers. This development, showcased at a software developer conference, aims to offer businesses and consumers greater privacy and faster AI responses for ChatGPT-style technologies. Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger positioned this as a "sea change moment" for tech innovation, with the company also announcing plans for a successor chip and partnerships in the AI space.

title: Trudeau promoted Vancouver backbench MP with extensive tech and media share holdings to Canadian Heritage portfolio
summary: Prime Minister Justin Trudeau appointed Vancouver Granville Liberal MP Taleeb Noormohamed as parliamentary secretary to Canadian Heritage Minister Pascal St-Onge. Noormohamed holds shares in numerous tech and media companies that fall under Canadian Heritage regulation, raising conflict of interest concerns, though an independent watchdog suggested a blind trust would keep him within legal bounds. Critics argue blind trusts are a "charade" and highlight perceived weaknesses in Canada's Conflict of Interest Act regarding public officials profiting from regulatory decisions.

title: Oracle says it's ready to cater to Canadian banks' open banking needs
summary: Oracle has declared its readiness to support Canadian banks with their open banking requirements, offering technology solutions as Canada implements its framework. Oracle's executive vice president for financial services, Sonny Singh, noted that the company's existing financial products, used globally, are well-positioned for this shift. This comes as Canadian banks are increasingly partnering with fintech firms and Oracle, despite recent market value losses due to strong cloud-computing competition.

title: Klaviyo rises 9% in muted NYSE debut after software vendor priced IPO at $30 a share
summary: Klaviyo, a marketing automation company, debuted on the NYSE after pricing its IPO at $30 a share, valuing the company at over $9 billion. Shares rose 9.2% on the first day, closing at $32.76, after opening higher. This IPO, along with Instacart's, attempts to revitalize a dormant tech IPO market, with Klaviyo benefiting from a strong relationship with e-commerce giant Shopify.

title: DTW23-Ignite: How Amdocs, Orange and Marand gain through Open API collaboration
summary: A collaboration between Amdocs, Orange, and Marand Software on developing an Open API for product configurators highlights the benefits of open standards in the telecom industry. This project allowed a small regional supplier, a tier-one communications service provider, and a global software giant to efficiently align on critical functionalities like configuration and pricing, leading to a standardized solution that can benefit the wider community. The initiative facilitated mutual learning, problem-solving, and the development of a robust, open-source API for product configuration.

title: Continuing our commitment to further open source security
summary: JPMorgan Chase is dedicated to enhancing open source security due to its critical role in innovation and potential vulnerabilities. The company actively participates in initiatives like OpenSSF and collaborates with financial institutions to address supply chain threats. Recent efforts include focusing on security education for developers, securing OSS repositories, and fostering cross-collaboration for incident response.

title: Persona-Powered Onboarding for Better Employee Engagement and Retention
summary: The article discusses the evolution of employee onboarding in the hybrid digital workplace, emphasizing the shift from traditional in-person processes to tailored, persona-based experiences. It highlights how organizations are leveraging digital tools and insights to create customized onboarding journeys that address the diverse needs of remote and hybrid employees, ultimately aiming to boost engagement and retention. The piece also stresses the importance of balancing technology with human connection to create a truly inclusive and productive workplace.

title: Cisco to Buy Splunk, a Software Company, for $28 Billion (Published 2023)
summary: Cisco announced its largest acquisition to date, agreeing to buy data-analysis software company Splunk for $28 billion in cash. This move signifies Cisco's strategic shift further into higher-margin software subscriptions and away from its traditional networking hardware roots. The deal faces potential scrutiny from antitrust regulators, although both companies believe there is little product overlap.

title: 3 Quantum Computing Stocks That Should Be on Every Investor’s Radar This Fall
summary: This article highlights three leading quantum computing stocks: IBM, Alphabet, and Microsoft, emphasizing their significant advancements in the field. IBM is recognized for its quantum breakthrough with over 100 qubits. Alphabet's quantum computer can solve complex problems far faster than traditional supercomputers, while Microsoft is advancing quantum computing to revolutionize chemistry and materials science.

title: Beware of the cyber Frankenstein: Figuring out Thoma Bravo’s next move
summary: Thoma Bravo, a major investment fund specializing in software, has acquired 15 cyber companies since 2009 for over $30 billion, leading some to call their resulting portfolio a "Frankenstein's monster" due to its potential to become a giant in the cyber market. The fund's strategy often involves buying public companies, taking them private to make operational changes, and then reselling or IPOing them, as seen with its identity management ventures where it has begun merging acquired entities. Despite questions about a master plan and concerns from the industry about potential impacts on innovation, Thoma Bravo continues to consolidate in key cyber categories like identity management, posing a growing competitive force.

title: Cisco Buys Cybersecurity Provider Splunk for $28 Billion
summary: Cisco Systems is acquiring cybersecurity software company Splunk for $28 billion ($157 per share in cash), a move seen by analysts as an "aggressive strategic play" in the cybersecurity market. This acquisition is expected to accelerate Cisco's revenue growth and gross margins, becoming cash flow positive in the first fiscal year. The deal, which provided a significant premium to Splunk shareholders, highlights Cisco's intent to compete strongly in the AI-driven software space against major rivals.

title: Meet the Innovators: Emergency medicine physician leverages innovative technology and AI to make life better for patients and providers
summary: Dr. Alex Stinard, an emergency medicine physician at UCF Lake Nona Hospital, is leveraging innovative technology and AI to improve patient care and provider experience. Partnering with HCA Healthcare's Department of Care Transformation and Innovation (CT&I), he helped pilot a generative AI technology that converts patient-provider conversations into medical notes, significantly reducing documentation burden. This initiative aims to allow clinicians to focus more on direct patient interaction, with plans for broader implementation across HCA Healthcare.

title: The 2024 State of IT: Cautious Optimism Fuels Business Spending
summary: Despite widespread fears of a potential economic recession, companies globally are planning to increase their IT budgets in 2024. This trend is driven by the need to update outdated infrastructure, enhance IT security, and a growing yet cautious optimism about future revenue growth. The report from Spiceworks Ziff Davis and Aberdeen Strategy & Research also highlights varying IT spending patterns based on company size and the challenges of finding skilled IT talent.

title: Indian auto insurance technology start-up Roadzen listed on Nasdaq
summary: Indian auto insurance technology start-up Roadzen has listed on Nasdaq, with its ordinary shares trading under the symbol "RDZN" and warrants under "RDZNW." The company, powered by artificial intelligence, achieved a pre-money equity value of $683 million and aims to lead the transformation of the auto insurance market through AI, mobility, and insurance. Roadzen's CEO, Rohan Malhotra, emphasizes the company's global vision and its commitment to building innovative AI technology for markets worldwide.

title: |‘Spider-Man No Way Home’ Figures Added to Hasbro's Marvel Legends Line
summary: Hasbro has unveiled a new wave of Marvel Legends action figures celebrating "Spider-Man: No Way Home," featuring the three live-action Spider-Men: Tobey Maguire, Andrew Garfield, and Tom Holland in his new suit. The collection also includes figures of MJ, Matt Murdock, and Sandman. These figures allow fans to commemorate the critically acclaimed film, which brought together the different generations of Spider-Man for an emotionally impactful storyline.

title: MSFU ETF Analysis: Dividends, Returns NASDAQ:MSFU
summary: This analysis details the Direxion Daily MSFT Bull 2X Shares (MSFU) ETF, designed to deliver 2x the daily price return of Microsoft stock. It highlights key statistics such as its $262.97M AUM, 2.56% dividend yield, and 0.99% expense ratio. The article also provides information on its structure, investment strategy, and recent performance, noting that the fund invests solely in cash.

title: AB US Large Cap Strategic Equities ETF
summary: This article provides a comprehensive overview of the AB US Large Cap Strategic Equities ETF (LRGC), including its price, holdings, expense ratio, and performance metrics. It details the fund's top holdings, concentration analysis, ESG scores, and comparisons to peer ETFs, offering a detailed guide for potential investors.

title: Amadeus to Work with Microsoft and Accenture to Develop New Generative AI-Powered Integrations to Support Corporate Travel Management
summary: Amadeus announced a collaboration with Microsoft and Accenture to integrate generative AI into its Cytric Easy travel and expense platform. This partnership aims to develop new AI-powered tools, including a digital assistant for corporate travelers within Microsoft Teams and a plugin for Microsoft 365 Copilot, to streamline travel management and enhance the booking experience using natural language.

title: Is Datadog a Buyout Target After Cisco's Splunk Acquisition?
summary: After Cisco's $28 billion acquisition of Splunk, Datadog (DDOG) is being considered a potential buyout target, given its strong long-term growth potential and current undervaluation. Despite a recent stock dip due to a cautious near-term revenue outlook, Datadog's expanding product suite and critical role in cloud-based monitoring and analytics make it attractive to competitors or large tech companies looking to bolster their cloud software presence. The article suggests that a further drop in its stock price could increase the likelihood of takeover talks.

title: What Market Pros Saw Last Earnings Season That Spurred Investments in Tech and AI Stocks
summary: Market experts, managing over $67 billion, analyzed second-quarter earnings reports and concluded that the bull market has room to run, a U.S. recession is unlikely, consumer spending remains strong, and AI is not in a bubble but rather a significant driver of corporate profits. They identified key sectors and companies benefiting from current growth trends, including broad-market strength beyond AI and Big Tech, and a re-emerging strong momentum in European economies.

title: Should Vanguard Russell 1000 Growth ETF (VONG) Be on Your Investing Radar?
summary: This article evaluates the Vanguard Russell 1000 Growth ETF (VONG) as a potential investment, highlighting its focus on large-cap growth stocks, low expense ratio, and strong performance. It details VONG's sector exposure, top holdings, and risk profile, while also suggesting alternative ETFs for consideration.

title: EPAM Expands Partnership with Microsoft - Becomes Globally Managed Enterprise Systems Integrator
summary: EPAM Systems, Inc. announced its new status as a Microsoft globally Managed Enterprise Systems Integrator, significantly expanding its strategic partnership with Microsoft. This enhanced status allows EPAM to accelerate technology innovation and digital transformation for enterprises by leveraging cloud-native, AI, and data expertise, particularly through end-to-end solution design and implementation in the cloud. The company will focus on building intelligent applications powered by Azure OpenAI Service and growing Microsoft certifications, building on its recent recognition as the 2023 Microsoft U.S. Azure Migration Partner of the Year.

title: Cisco's $28 billion Splunk deal may ignite software deal frenzy
summary: Cisco's $28 billion acquisition of Splunk is expected to spark a new wave of software vendor acquisitions by other technology giants, driven by the appeal of predictable subscription revenue. Investment bankers and analysts suggest that Splunk's shift to a subscription model and the improving M&A outlook for software companies make similar firms attractive targets for major tech conglomerates like Microsoft, Adobe, and Oracle. This comes as valuations for software stocks are considered cheap by historical standards, encouraging dealmaking in a sector that has seen a recent slowdown.

title: 11 Five9 Contact Center Features for Incredible CX
summary: This article details eleven key Five9 contact center features designed to enhance customer experience (CX). It highlights Five9's commitment to leveraging AI, offering robust omnichannel capabilities, and providing tools for agent assistance, productivity, and workforce management. The platform aims to provide a scalable, customizable, and integrated solution for businesses to improve customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.

title: Capcom may start charging $70 for new games after all, president says prices are too low
summary: Capcom's president, Haruhiro Tsujimoto, stated that current game prices are "too low" given the significant increase in development costs, suggesting a potential shift to $70 for new titles. While a price hike could impact Capcom's goal of selling 100 million games annually, the company might still implement it for major releases like Dragon's Dogma 2 and the next Monster Hunter, alongside smaller games at lower price points. This move would align Capcom with other major publishers who have already adopted the $70 pricing for next-gen games.

title: Silicon Hegemon: Could China Take Over Taiwan’s Semiconductor Industry Without Invading?
summary: This article explores the high-impact, low-probability scenario of China taking control of Taiwan's semiconductor industry, particularly TSMC, without a full-scale military invasion. It outlines hypothetical coercion tactics short of war, such as blockades and economic pressure, that could force Taiwan into ceding control. The authors propose military, regulatory, and policy responses for Taiwan and its allies to prevent such an outcome, emphasizing deterrence and preparedness to defend free passage to and from Taiwan.

title: Nuance Releases Generative AI Copilot for Clinical Documentation
summary: Nuance Communications, Inc., a Microsoft Company, has launched Dragon Ambient eXperience (DAX) Copilot, a generative AI-powered tool for clinical documentation. It streamlines the creation of draft clinical summaries from patient conversations, aiming to reduce administrative burden and clinician burnout. This solution integrates Nuance's conversational and ambient AI with generative AI models and is part of the broader Nuance Dragon suite.

title: Lumen CEO Kate Johnson on Seattle tech, AI, lessons from Microsoft, and ‘cloudifying’ telecom
summary: Lumen Technologies CEO Kate Johnson discusses her efforts to reinvent the telecom company by "cloudifying" its operations and adapting to the rapid growth of data and AI. She highlights Seattle's importance as a tech hub for Lumen's services and shares insights from her past experience at Microsoft, including their pilot program for Microsoft 365 Copilot to enhance productivity. Johnson also touches on cultural changes within Lumen to foster innovation and problem-solving.

title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella to testify on Monday in Google antitrust trial
summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella is slated to testify on Monday as a witness for the U.S. Justice Department in its antitrust trial against Google. Nadella is expected to discuss Microsoft's efforts to expand its Edge browser and Bing search engine, and the challenges posed by Google's market dominance. The government alleges Google improperly paid $10 billion annually to maintain its default search engine status on various devices.

title: Adobe hit with $33.8 million patent verdict over digital licensing technology
summary: A Delaware federal court jury has ordered Adobe to pay ViaTech Technologies nearly $33.8 million for infringing a patent related to digital licensing technology. ViaTech's lawsuit claimed Adobe's software activation system for products like Acrobat and Photoshop violated its patent for controlling access to digital content. Adobe expressed disappointment with the verdict and plans to explore post-trial and appellate options.

title: Supermicro At 30: From Designing AI Chips To Selling AI Systems
summary: Supermicro, founded 30 years ago, began with Charles Liang's vision to improve server motherboards and power supplies after working on an AI processor design. The company has grown into a $10 billion systems business with global manufacturing facilities and aims for $20 billion in the next three years, continuously expanding its operations and exploring new factory locations.

title: These 3 hiring companies reveal their tech stacks and business applications
summary: This article explores the technology stacks and business applications used by three companies: Chatham Financial, CubeSmart, and Fastmail. It provides insights into the tools these organizations leverage for product development, communication, and project management, offering potential job seekers a glimpse into their operational environments and culture.

title: Cisco-Splunk under the microscope: Joint customers weigh in
summary: Cisco's $28 billion acquisition of Splunk is viewed positively by joint customers, particularly for strengthening Cisco's security and observability portfolios, despite some concerns about potential pricing changes. A flash survey from Enterprise Technology Research revealed that while sentiment is generally favorable, especially regarding synergies and product overlap, customers expressed apprehension about higher prices and a 'brain drain' from Splunk. The deal is seen as a strategic move for Cisco to boost its software revenue and international presence, offering Splunk a lifeline after its challenging transition to a cloud and subscription model.

title: What is Joule? SAP’s new GenAI assistant
summary: SAP has introduced Joule, a new natural-language generative AI co-pilot designed to be embedded across its cloud enterprise portfolio. Joule aims to provide proactive and contextualized insights by analyzing data from SAP solutions and third-party sources, helping users work faster and achieve better business outcomes. SAP CEO Christian Klein emphasizes that Joule will understand user intent, leveraging SAP's extensive enterprise user base and a responsible approach to Business AI.

title: Elon Musk's X hit with trademark lawsuit from marketing agency
summary: X Corp, formerly Twitter, is facing a trademark infringement lawsuit from a legal-marketing company called X Social Media. The Florida-based company claims that X Corp's rebranding is causing consumer confusion and has led to lost revenue, given their prior use and federal trademark for "X Social Media" since 2016. This lawsuit is potentially the first of many such disputes due to the common use of the letter "X" in tech branding.

title: What’s Changed: 2023 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Sales Force Automation Platforms
summary: This article summarizes Gartner's 2023 Magic Quadrant for Sales Force Automation Platforms, identifying 13 significant providers. It categorizes vendors into Leaders, Challengers, Niche Players, and Visionaries, detailing their key solutions, recent updates, and differentiating strengths. The report highlights Salesforce, Microsoft, and Oracle as Leaders, and discusses emerging trends like generative AI and enhanced mobile capabilities within SFA solutions.

title: DXC Technology Adds Industry Veteran Andrew Wilson to Senior Leadership Team
summary: DXC Technology has appointed Andrew Wilson as Executive Vice President and Global Lead, Modern Workplace, effective October 1, 2023. Wilson, with over 35 years of experience in IT services, is the third high-profile executive to join DXC under its new offering-led operating model, aiming to drive financial growth and expansion. This appointment completes the senior leadership team under the new model, which is expected to transition DXC from a focus on stability to future growth.

title: Rockwell Automation goes cloud-native on Azure to bring modern software development paradigms to the factory floor
summary: Rockwell Automation, the world's largest industrial automation company, is leveraging Microsoft Azure, Visual Studio Code, and GitHub to deliver its first cloud-native application, FactoryTalk Design Studio. This move aims to bring modern software development practices like object-oriented programming and collaboration features to the factory floor, overcoming traditional limitations of on-premises applications. The partnership with Microsoft has enabled Rockwell Automation to enhance productivity, scalability, and security for its customers and its own development teams, significantly accelerating the delivery of new features and value.

title: An exclusive conversation with Toni Townes-Whitley, one of only two Black women running a Fortune 500 company
summary: Toni Townes-Whitley has officially become the CEO of Science Applications International Corp. (SAIC), making her one of only two Black women leading a Fortune 500 company. In an exclusive interview, she discusses her plans for the technology integrator, highlighting its role in providing mission support, IT, and engineering services to U.S. government agencies, including the Department of Defense and intelligence departments. Townes-Whitley also shares leadership lessons learned from Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella and offers advice on diversifying corporate CEO ranks.

title: Generative AI in the enterprise raises questions for CIOs
summary: Generative AI is rapidly reshaping enterprise technology, forcing CIOs to address critical issues regarding adoption strategy, architectural implications, and evolving IT management responsibilities. Many organizations, including Walmart, are opting for a "buy and customize" approach to LLMs rather than building from scratch. The article also highlights the importance of speed in adoption, the need for robust AI architectures, and the shifting role of IT leadership towards enabling business users while maintaining strong governance and security.

title: ConocoPhillips goes global with digital twins
summary: ConocoPhillips is expanding its use of digital twin technology across its entire portfolio after initial successes in its major fields, aiming to optimize safety and efficiency. This global program, awarded a 2023 CIO 100 Award, helps the company maximize extraction from existing assets, manage volatile industry prices, and reduce GHG emissions. The company is developing a common platform and community to accelerate deployment and connect digital twins with other systems for greater insights and value.

title: The Fortune 500 adds a second Black woman CEO in SAIC’s Toni Townes-Whitley
summary: Toni Townes-Whitley has been appointed CEO of Science Applications International Corp. (SAIC), making her one of only two Black women leading Fortune 500 companies. Her appointment, following former CEO Nazzic Keene, also marks a rare female CEO-to-female CEO transition. Townes-Whitley aims to articulate SAIC's value proposition and build a stronger pipeline for diverse leaders in national security roles.

title: Crypto Prices Today: BTC, SOL, CRV, PEPE All Record 24H Losses
summary: The global cryptocurrency market cap decreased by 1.62% in the last 24 hours, with Bitcoin (BTC), Pepe (PEPE), Solana (SOL), and Curve DAO Token (CRV) all experiencing losses. This downturn followed a brief positive start to the month, potentially driven by profit-taking after the approval of VanEck’s Ethereum Strategy ETF. Despite the overall market slump, price analysis for individual cryptocurrencies suggests potential recovery or further declines depending on key support and resistance levels.

title: Boeing PAC joins fleet of corporate givers to Kentucky Republican Party building fund
summary: Aerospace giant Boeing's PAC donated $100,000 to the Kentucky Republican Party's building fund, bringing the total corporate donations for the renovation and expansion of the Mitch McConnell Building to $2.75 million. summary: This article analyzes retailer software purchasing behaviors based on Gartner Digital Markets' 2024 Tech Trends Survey, revealing that 57% of retailers plan to increase software spending, prioritizing marketing and IT, despite nearly half (49%) experiencing regret over past software purchases. The insights emphasize that software providers must address usability, support, and cost transparency while understanding nuanced buyer needs to mitigate churn and effectively target the retail market.

title: Big tech is changing in China, and so are its hiring plans
summary: China's big tech companies are undergoing significant changes in their hiring strategies due to slowing growth, corporate restructuring, and intensified market competition. After periods of massive expansion and subsequent layoffs, firms like Alibaba and Tencent are now focusing on "efficiency enhancement" and higher-skilled positions. The new hiring directions primarily target overseas business expansion and artificial intelligence development, reflecting a strategic shift in the industry.

title: One ETF that focuses on employee happiness is outperforming the market this year
summary: An ETF focused on companies with high employee happiness, the Harbor Human Capital Factor U.S. Large Cap ETF (HAPI), has outperformed the S&P 500 this year, climbing nearly 25% compared to the benchmark's less than 20% gain. The fund's strategy is based on Irrational Capital's extensive employee surveys and publicly available data, creating a "human capital score" that is considered a novel and uncorrelated investment factor. While the large-cap HAPI fund includes major tech stocks contributing to its performance, a similar small-cap ETF (HAPS) is also available, offering potential for future growth.

summary: The Invesco QQQ Trust (NASDAQ:QQQ) is highlighted as an excellent long-term investment, having seen a 46% gain this year due to its focus on growth stocks. summary: Oracle has been recognized as a Leader in the 2023 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Strategic Cloud Platform Services, highlighting its growth and position among global hyperscale cloud providers. summary: Generative AI (GenAI) is poised to fundamentally disrupt industries by driving the cost of knowledge activation towards zero and closing the knowledge cycle, creating a virtuous loop of expanding knowledge. This disruption will impact firms differently based on their use of knowledge: high-expertise firms will see their human know-how amplified, while data-rich firms with repeatable processes will gain efficiency, potentially leading to growth. New competitors will also emerge, capitalizing on knowledge capture and private model delivery.

title: H&R Block unveils conversational AI tax assistant for DIY filers
summary: H&R Block has launched a conversational AI chatbot, "AI Tax Assist," to help DIY tax filers with their tax questions, leveraging generative AI similar to ChatGPT and H&R Block's tax expertise. The chatbot is integrated into the company's online DIY tax software, providing real-time assistance on forms, deductions, and credits, and can direct users to human experts if needed. This move positions H&R Block alongside competitors like Intuit, which also introduced an AI-powered assistant for its TurboTax product earlier this year.

title: Google, AES, others to create marketplace for 24/7 hourly renewable energy certificates
summary: Google, AES, Microsoft, and Constellation have partnered with LevelTen Energy to create a marketplace for "granular certificates," a new type of energy attribute certificate that tracks renewable energy generation on an hourly, location-specific basis. This initiative aims to provide more accurate signals for renewable energy development and help corporate and utility buyers meet 24/7 clean energy goals. The platform is expected to launch next year, offering both forward and spot markets for these certificates.

title: New KV-Botnet Targeting Cisco, DrayTek, and Fortinet Devices for Stealthy Attacks
summary: A new botnet, dubbed KV-botnet by Lumen Technologies' Black Lotus Labs, is leveraging compromised firewalls and routers from Cisco, DrayTek, Fortinet, and NETGEAR to facilitate covert data transfer for advanced persistent threat actors, including China-linked Volt Typhoon. The botnet consists of two complementary clusters (KV and JDY) and has been active since at least February 2022, primarily targeting edge devices in enterprises. The malware operates entirely in-memory, making detection difficult but vulnerable to power cycling, though re-infection remains a risk.

title: Arm boss's chilling warning humans WILL lose control of AI as he demands 'override'
summary: Rene Haas, CEO of Arm Holdings, has issued a stark warning that humans risk losing control over AI and calls for an "override" or "backdoor" to shut down advanced AI systems. He believes AI will profoundly change every aspect of life within the next five to ten years, echoing the company's past role in the smartphone revolution. This comes as Microsoft invests significantly in UK data centers for AI development, with a focus on safety alongside economic benefits.

title: Call translation services new battleground in AI race
summary: The coming year will see a surge in real-time phone call translation services driven by AI, with Korean tech firms like SK Telecom and Samsung Electronics entering the fray. SK Telecom is launching its "A. call translator" service within its existing AI app, supporting four languages initially and expanding to 11. Samsung, conversely, plans to integrate its generative AI model "Samsung Gauss" directly into its new Galaxy S24 phones, offering on-device translation without external internet access, emphasizing privacy and reduced latency.

summary: The article highlights the top-performing Artificial Intelligence (AI) ETFs of 2023, with returns as high as 71%. summary: This article outlines five reasons why investors should consider avoiding Microsoft (MSFT) stock at the moment, despite its historical success.
