This initiative, led by Pradeep Sindhu, aims to create an alternative to Nvidia's ConnectX-7 card, potentially making AI model training faster and more cost-effective for Microsoft and OpenAI. The project reflects Microsoft's broader strategy to integrate AI across its products and optimize its computing infrastructure.

title: Intel Launches World’s First Systems Foundry Designed for the AI Era
summary: Intel has launched Intel Foundry, positioning it as the world's first systems foundry tailored for the AI era, with an expanded process roadmap targeting leadership by the end of the decade. The company announced new process technologies, ASAT capabilities, key customer design wins including Microsoft, and strong support from ecosystem partners. Intel Foundry also emphasized its commitment to sustainability, aiming for 100% renewable electricity and net-zero emissions by specific target dates.

title: Constellation Named One of America’s Most Just Companies by JUST Capital and CNBC
summary: Constellation has been recognized as one of America's Most Just Companies by JUST Capital and CNBC, earning a spot in the "JUST 100" for its commitment to employees, customers, communities, the environment, and shareholders. The company's efforts in accelerating the transition to a carbon-free economy, fostering an inclusive culture, and its significant investments in clean energy initiatives were highlighted. Constellation's dedication to social impact, including philanthropic giving, volunteer hours, and workforce development programs, also contributed to its recognition.

title: After Earnings, Is Arista Stock a Buy, a Sell, or Fairly Valued?
summary: Morningstar maintains that Arista Networks' stock is overvalued despite strong fourth-quarter earnings and a bullish long-term forecast driven by high-speed cloud providers and AI investments. While the company is positioned for significant market share gains, its current valuation is considered overexuberant. Morningstar assigns Arista a "wide moat" rating due to its intangible assets and customer switching costs in high-speed networking, but also a "High Uncertainty Rating" due to customer concentration and challenges in expanding into new market segments.

title: Intel Launches World’s First Systems Foundry Designed for the AI Era
summary: Intel has launched Intel Foundry, positioning it as the world's first systems foundry for the AI era, and announced an expanded process roadmap including Intel 14A and specialized node evolutions. The company affirmed its "five-nodes-in-four-years" process roadmap is on track and highlighted significant customer momentum, including Microsoft choosing Intel's 18A process for a chip design, alongside strong support from ecosystem partners. Intel outlined its commitment to sustainability, aiming to be the industry's most sustainable foundry with goals for 100% renewable electricity, net-positive water, and net-zero waste by 2030, and net-zero Scope 1 & 2 GHG emissions by 2040.

title: DigitalOcean beats expectations under the helm of new CEO Paddy Srinivasan
summary: DigitalOcean Holdings Inc. exceeded earnings and revenue expectations for the last quarter and provided optimistic guidance for the current quarter, leading to a stock surge. The company, under new CEO Paddy Srinivasan, is strategically focusing on AI solutions for small businesses, utilizing its Paperspace platform to offer Nvidia H100 GPUs, and demonstrating strong growth in its annual revenue run rate and average revenue per customer. Despite a slowdown in growth in the final quarter, analysts believe AI will be a key strategy for rekindling growth under the new leadership.

title: Palo Alto Networks loses over $30 billion in market cap, sends shockwaves throughout cyber market
summary: Palo Alto Networks experienced its largest one-day share drop, losing over $30 billion in market cap after cutting its annual billings forecast due to softer client spending and steep promotions. The company's new strategy involves offering up to six months of free services to customers and an aggressive marketing approach to encourage "platform consolidation," sparking concerns about a potential price war in the cybersecurity market. This move could significantly impact competitors, particularly smaller startups, and reshape the industry landscape.

title: Dimensional ETFs and More: New on Syfe Custom Portfolio
summary: Syfe Custom Portfolio is expanding its offerings with new equity ETFs from Dimensional Fund Advisors, focusing on value and quality tilts, alongside additional quality-focused and equally-weighted Nasdaq ETFs. The article details Dimensional's factor-based investing approach and highlights specific ETFs added to the platform, including options for accredited investors such as Bitcoin ETFs and a Nasdaq Equity Premium Income ETF. Syfe also explains how to utilize Custom Portfolios to complement existing investments by allowing tactical allocation based on asset class, risk, geography, and sector.

title: Ecolab Appoints Judson Althoff to Board of Directors
summary: Ecolab has appointed Judson Althoff, Microsoft’s chief commercial officer, to its board of directors, effective February 21, 2024. Althoff will serve as an independent director and a member of the Audit and Finance Committees, bringing extensive global leadership, sales, business, and executive experience in high technology to the board. His deep knowledge of artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and the global technology ecosystem is expected to support Ecolab’s digital innovation and long-term profitable growth.

title: Intel’s CEO Says AI Is the Key to the Company’s Comeback
summary: Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger states that AI and renewed investment in cutting-edge manufacturing are crucial for the company's comeback, allowing it to become a leading supplier of AI chips. He announced a rebrand of Intel's foundry business with Microsoft as a major customer for its new manufacturing technology. Gelsinger expects Intel's 18A manufacturing process to compete with TSMC and highlights advancements like backside power and being first in line for next-generation lithography machines as key differentiators.

title: Disturbing AI Images of Children Found for Sale on Shutterstock
summary: PetaPixel discovered disturbing, sexually suggestive AI-generated images of children, including some with offensive text and others depicting inappropriate interactions, for sale on Shutterstock. These images were created using Shutterstock's internal AI image generator. Following PetaPixel's report, Shutterstock removed the content, identified and banned the user, and implemented new safety blocklists, acknowledging challenges in moderating AI-generated content.

title: Utilities weigh power demand from AI amid clean energy transition
summary: Utilities in Wisconsin are grappling with how to meet the surging energy demands of artificial intelligence (AI) and large data centers, such as Microsoft's planned Racine County facility, while simultaneously pursuing clean energy goals. This increased demand poses challenges to carbon reduction targets and the state's energy grid reliability, prompting discussions among utility executives, industry groups, and consumer advocates about the role of natural gas, energy efficiency, and legislative support for infrastructure development. Different stakeholders express concerns about grid stability, the financial burden on consumers, and the need for proactive planning to accommodate future energy needs for AI and electrification.

title: Ecolab appoints Judson Althoff to Board of Directors
summary: Ecolab Inc. has appointed Judson Althoff, Microsoft’s chief commercial officer, to its Board of Directors, effective February 21, 2024. Althoff will serve as an independent director and a member of the Audit and Finance Committees, bringing his extensive experience in technology, artificial intelligence, and cloud computing to support Ecolab's digital innovation and profitable growth. Ecolab leaders Christophe Beck and Dave MacLennan emphasized the value of Althoff's expertise in strengthening the board and driving strategic initiatives for the company.

title: SPY ETF Reaches Record High Amid Nvidia-Fueled AI Rally—Key Chart Pattern to Watch
summary: The SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) reached a record high, mirroring the S&P 500's surge driven by mega-cap technology stocks, particularly after Nvidia's strong earnings report. Nvidia, along with other AI-related companies like Microsoft and Broadcom, contributed significantly to the rally, highlighting the outsized influence of Magnificent Seven stocks within the SPY's portfolio. Investors should watch the SPY's rising wedge pattern for potential breakouts or breakdowns, which could signal future price movements.

title: Vice Media to stop publishing on its website, lay off 'several' hundreds
summary: Vice Media has announced it will cease publishing content on its website, vice.com, and lay off several hundred of its employees. CEO Bruce Dixon stated that distributing digital content is no longer cost-effective, and the company will focus on other distribution channels. This move reflects the ongoing financial struggles in the media industry, with many legacy and digital media brands facing job cuts or shutdowns.

title: Lippert Named ‘Most Responsible Company’ by Newsweek
summary: LCI Industries (NYSE: LCII), also known as Lippert, has been recognized by Newsweek as one of America's Most Responsible Companies for 2024, ranking 221st overall and 5th in the Automotive & Components category. This achievement highlights Lippert's “Everyone Matters” initiative, which has focused on company culture, philanthropy, and leadership, embodying its "Business as a Force for Good" mantra. CEO Jason Lippert attributes this recognition to the company's commitment to investing in its people and culture over several years.

title: All things AI with Melissa Waters
summary: Melissa Waters, CMO of Upwork, discusses her company's approach to AI, emphasizing a human-centered policy that prioritizes safety and responsible data handling. She details how Upwork's marketing teams are using AI tools like ChatGPT and Regie.ai to boost productivity, customize content, and expand their online presence. Waters also highlights the potential of AI for hyper-personalization in marketing and advises brands to encourage experimentation among employees while addressing concerns about job redundancy.

title: SPY First ETF to Reach $500B in Assets
summary: The SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) made history by becoming the first ETF to reach $500 billion in assets under management. This milestone follows the S&P 500 surpassing the 5,000 mark, driven by strong performance from large technology companies. Despite significant outflows, the fund's liquidity and broad investor base are cited as key drivers of its growth.

title: How Nvidia grew to a trillion-dollar company fueling the AI revolution
summary: Nvidia has grown into a nearly $3 trillion company by specializing in Graphics Processing Units (GPUs), which have become crucial for the artificial intelligence revolution. Initially used for gaming, GPUs' ability to perform concurrent calculations makes them ideal for AI, giving Nvidia a significant first-mover advantage and market dominance. The company's unique technology and supply chain have led to widespread adoption by major tech firms, with discussions emerging about potential shortages and the need for continued investment in chip manufacturing.

title: 6 Reasons to Avoid IBM (IBM) At This Moment
summary: This article outlines six reasons why investors should avoid IBM (IBM) at this moment, citing prolonged decline in profits, falling behind in the AI race, a significant debt load, declining market share, an outdated business model, and slowing earnings growth. It highlights how these financial and competitive challenges make IBM fundamentally unattractive for long-term value investors with a multi-year horizon.

title: GE Vernova and Dragos team up to protect electric grids from cyber threats
summary: GE Vernova’s Grid Solutions and Dragos Inc. have partnered to provide comprehensive industrial cybersecurity solutions to enhance electric grid resilience. This collaboration will integrate their expertise in grid automation and operational technology (OT) cybersecurity, offering advanced functionalities like asset visibility, proactive threat detection, and rapid incident response to protect critical infrastructure. The partnership aims to safeguard critical infrastructure and other OT environments for GE Vernova's global grid automation customers.

title: Secure 5G Private Wireless for Enterprise Digital Transformation: Wipro & Nokia
summary: Wipro and Nokia have partnered to launch a joint 5G private wireless solution aimed at accelerating enterprise digital transformation. This solution will provide a secure and reliable 5G private wireless network integrated with operational infrastructure, offering improved connectivity speed, real-time insights, and low-latency data processing. It targets industries such as manufacturing, energy, utilities, transportation, and sports entertainment, leveraging Nokia's hardware and software with Wipro's strategic guidance and platforms.

title: Telefónica partners with Microsoft to incorporate generative AI into Kernel
summary: Telefónica has announced a partnership with Microsoft to integrate Azure AI Studio into its digital ecosystem, Kernel, to leverage generative AI while ensuring customer privacy. The collaboration, revealed at MWC by Telefónica's CDO Chema Alonso and Microsoft's EVP Jason Zander, will allow "data scientists" to use generative AI capabilities with Kernel's data and APIs securely. Additionally, Telefónica will be part of Microsoft's Azure Programmable Connectivity (APC) service, enhancing developer access to network APIs.

title: TravelCenters of America Opens 300th Location
summary: TravelCenters of America (TA), a bp brand, has opened its 300th travel center in Walton, Kentucky, marking a significant milestone in its strategic network growth plan. The new 12,200-square-foot facility offers various amenities and dining options, and TA is celebrating by awarding double fuel points to professional drivers and holding an Instagram contest. The company, acquired by bp in May, plans to open 20 new locations this year and expand its services, including EV charging stations and improved loyalty programs.

summary: The Software Report has released its list of the Top 25 Cloud Computing Companies of 2024, highlighting the industry's rapid growth and innovation. Noteworthy awardees include Visma, Qualys, Cloudflare, Samsara, and Mirantis, each contributing significantly to the evolving cloud landscape.

summary: Equinix, a global digital infrastructure company, has announced the appointment of Merrie Williamson as Executive Vice President and Chief Customer and Revenue Officer (CCRO), effective March 25. Williamson brings over 20 years of experience from leadership roles at Microsoft and Intel, where she focused on digital transformation and AI. In her new role, she will oversee Equinix's entire customer experience and go-to-market strategy, including sales, marketing, and regional management, with a focus on leveraging technology and partnerships for customer success.

title: After Earnings and a Massive Rally, Is Nvidia Stock a Buy, a Sell, or Fairly Valued?
summary: Following a strong fiscal fourth-quarter earnings report and a significant stock rally, Morningstar assesses Nvidia's valuation. The "Very High" Uncertainty Rating reflects potential competition and the volatile nature of some of its markets.

title: Intel’s new Intel vPro platform to power the next generation of AI PCs
summary: Intel has launched its new Intel vPro platform, integrating Intel Arc GPUs and Intel Core 14th Gen CPUs, to accelerate artificial intelligence capabilities on personal computers. This platform aims to introduce the "AI PC" era, offering significant productivity gains and enhanced security features for businesses and educational institutions. Over 100 new device models from various partners will be powered by this technology.

title: Our Year with Copilot: What Microsoft Has Learned About AI at Work
summary: Microsoft shares key insights from its year-long experience with Copilot, detailing how the company implemented and scaled AI internally as its "customer zero." The article focuses on four main lessons: prioritizing high-impact functions for AI rollout, identifying and empowering internal champions, making employee training a priority, and building consistent AI usage habits across the organization. These lessons offer a blueprint for other companies looking to integrate AI into their workflows.

title: NBA® 2K24: MyTEAM Available Worldwide on iOS and Android
summary: NBA® 2K24: MyTEAM, a free-to-download mobile game, is now available worldwide on iOS and Android, allowing players to synchronize their progress between console and mobile devices. This enables users to assemble their dream NBA lineups, play various MyTEAM modes, earn XP, and collect rewards on the go. The game features quality NBA 2K gameplay, stunning graphics, and compatibility with external controllers, offering a realistic NBA simulation experience.

title: Wipro's FullStride Cloud Services Drives ManpowerGroup's Azure Transformation
summary: Wipro Limited announced the completion of ManpowerGroup's largest data center migration in Europe to Microsoft Azure, facilitated by Wipro FullStride Cloud Services. This transformation involved moving over 150 critical IT applications across 15 European countries to the Azure platform, enhancing ManpowerGroup's operational efficiency, scalability, and sustainability while reducing its carbon footprint. The project, completed in under a year, establishes an enterprise-grade foundation for innovation and improved resilience.

title: A Wonderful Options-Based Dividend-Focused ETF?
summary: This article discusses the new Swan Global Enhanced Dividend Income Strategy (SCLZ) ETF, which combines Swan Global's options expertise with O'Shares Investment's stock selection. The ETF aims to provide sustainable retirement income through active management of options on dividend-growing companies, focusing on profitability and quality stocks. Key takeaways from a recent webcast highlighted the importance of active management, a profitability-based stock index, and a preference for "boring companies" that consistently generate dividends.

title: NANC ETF Tracking Democrat Stock Trades Beating S&P 500 on Tech Bets
summary: The Unusual Whales Democratic ETF (NANC), which tracks stock trades by Democrats in Congress, has outperformed the S&P 500 since its launch in February 2023, returning 30% compared to the S&P 500's 24%. This outperformance is largely attributed to its significant holdings in mega-cap tech stocks like Microsoft, Amazon, Apple, and Nvidia. In contrast, a similar ETF tracking Republican trades (KRUZ) has only gained about 15% over the same period.

title: VONG ETF: A Great Way to Invest in Top Growth Stocks
summary: The Vanguard Russell 1000 Growth ETF (VONG) offers a straightforward and effective way to invest in a diverse range of top growth stocks. With a strong track record of impressive returns, a low expense ratio of 0.08%, and a portfolio that includes leading mega-cap technology companies and other high-growth firms, VONG is considered a compelling option for investors seeking exposure to large-cap growth in the U.S. market. The ETF's holdings are highly rated, with many featuring Outperform-equivalent Smart Scores.

summary: While Nvidia has achieved an impressive 1,904% return over the past five years, three mid-cap stocks have significantly outpaced it: e.l.f. Beauty (2,491%), Super Micro Computer (4,175%), and Celsius Holdings (over 5,300%). Investors are advised to use diversified funds (ETFs and mutual funds) to mitigate volatility and risk associated with individual small-cap stock picks.

title: KT teams up with Amazon to bolster B2B generative AI
summary: South Korean telecom provider KT Corp. has partnered with Amazon Web Services (AWS) to enhance its B2B generative AI services, aiming to transform into an AI-focused ICT company. This collaboration involves developing generative AI based on Amazon Bedrock and offering cloud-based private 5G network services. KT plans to hire more AI and ICT experts, integrate AI into performance reviews, and upgrade its internal generative AI platform "Gen.AIDU" using various LLMs.

title: 5 Best Mind Mapping Software & Tools (Free & Paid)
summary: This article reviews the five best mind mapping software and tools for project management, including options for free and paid users. It highlights FigJam for visual workflows, Miro for collaboration, Lucidchart for complex projects, Canva for custom graphics, and WorkCanvas by monday.com for integrations. The review provides detailed information on features, pricing, pros, and cons for each tool, helping businesses choose the best fit for their project visualization and collaboration needs.

title: Microsoft spends big on data center land near Gainesville
summary: Microsoft Corp. has acquired 124 acres of land in Gainesville, Virginia, for over $465 million, intending to build data centers. The property, located near Conway Robinson State Forest and Manassas National Battlefield Park, is already zoned for heavy industrial use, accommodating data center development. A rezoning application has been submitted to allow for nearly 4 million square feet of data centers and a new electric substation.

title: Citadel's Ken Griffin Oversees $500 Billion in Managed Assets: These Are His Top 5 Holdings
summary: Ken Griffin's Citadel Advisors manages $500 billion in assets and is a top-performing hedge fund. SEC filings reveal its top non-derivative holdings, which include the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust, Nvidia, Microsoft, Amazon, and Advanced Micro Devices. These investments highlight a strategy of betting on market indexes and major players in tech and AI while acknowledging potential risks and sector trends.

title: Dow's nearly 125-point rally led by gains for shares of NVIDIA Corp., Cisco
summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose by nearly 125 points, primarily driven by strong performances from NVIDIA Corp. and Cisco Systems Inc. NVIDIA's shares surged after an analyst upgrade, while Cisco remained relatively flat despite an analyst reiteration of an overweight rating. The overall market saw NVIDIA and Cisco among the top gainers, contrasting with losses from other Dow components.

title: Magnificent Seven vs. the ‘Granolas’: How does Europe’s version stack up?
summary: This article compares the U.S. "Magnificent Seven" stocks with Europe's "Granolas," highlighting their differences in market value, sector diversity, and profitability. While the Magnificent Seven are largely tech-driven and exceptionally profitable, the Granolas offer broader sector representation and solid returns, often trading at a discount despite their strong performance. The piece examines historical returns, valuation ratios, and individual stock assessments for both groups.

title: OTA Ruling Favors Microsoft: Opens Door for Taxpayer Refunds on Foreign Dividends
summary: The California Office of Tax Appeals (OTA) recently sided with Microsoft in a case regarding foreign dividend income, allowing 100% of such income to be included in the California sales factor for Water’s Edge filers, despite a dividend received deduction (DRD). This decision, which resulted in a significant refund for Microsoft, signals an opportunity for other similarly impacted taxpayers to file refund claims, generally for tax years beginning with 2019. The ruling overturns the Franchise Tax Board’s interpretation that disallowed including the DRD portion in the sales factor denominator.

title: Microsoft Seeks to Dismiss Parts of Suit Filed by The New York Times (Published 2024)
summary: Microsoft has filed a motion to dismiss parts of a lawsuit brought by The New York Times, which accuses Microsoft and OpenAI of copyright infringement for using its articles to train AI technologies like ChatGPT. Microsoft argues that large language models (LLMs) do not supplant the market for news articles and compares them to videocassette recorders (VCRs), which were legally allowed despite initial copyright concerns. The company claims the Times has not shown actual harm, echoing a similar motion made by OpenAI.

title: ‘Funflation’ & Technology Driving Music Industry Resurgence
summary: The music industry is experiencing a resurgence fueled by "funflation" (increased spending on live events) and technological advancements such as streaming, AI, and blockchain. Record-breaking attendance at concerts, rising streaming subscriptions, and innovation are driving growth for companies like Live Nation, Universal Music, and Warner Music Group. The MUSQ ETF offers a pure-play investment into this evolving and increasingly monetized global music market.

title: Tackle large volumes of data with new solution from SLB for Azure Data Manager for Energy
summary: SLB has partnered with Microsoft to launch the Enterprise Data Solution, designed to work seamlessly with Azure Data Manager for Energy. This new solution aims to help energy companies manage, ingest, curate, and discover large volumes of diverse data more efficiently, reducing manual intervention and optimizing workflows. By enhancing data quality and accessibility, it enables better decision-making and leverages AI across the planning to operations lifecycle in the energy sector.

title: We Energies plans to spend $335M on Microsoft development in Mount Pleasant
summary: We Energies plans to invest $335 million in a distribution project for Microsoft's data center development in Mount Pleasant, Wisconsin, on land originally designated for Foxconn. Due to a 2017 law related to the Foxconn project, this substantial investment does not require approval from the Public Service Commission, raising concerns about oversight. Microsoft's data centers are highly energy-intensive, and there's a growing push to ensure residential customers are not burdened with the increased energy costs.

title: HP Inc. CEO: Security Will Be A ‘Key Advantage’ In Our AI PC Strategy
summary: HP CEO Enrique Lores announced that security will be a "key advantage" in the company's AI PC strategy, emphasizing local large language model processing for enhanced security, lower costs, and faster performance compared to cloud solutions. HP plans to leverage its Wolf Security technologies to protect AI models running on these new PCs, which are expected to launch in the second half of 2024. Lores believes AI PCs represent a significant opportunity for channel partners due to device sales and the coming wave of AI-optimized software.

summary: Expedia Group successfully integrated generative AI tools like GitHub Copilot by undergoing a multi-year "platform convergence" initiative, unifying its previously disparate tech stacks. This consolidation allowed for faster product launches, improved developer productivity, and a more streamlined approach to AI adoption across its brands. The company also implemented rigorous guardrails and established a Responsible AI council to address challenges like AI hallucinations and ensure ethical, scalable use of AI with tangible business benefits.

summary: Electric Hydrogen, a green hydrogen company, secured $50 million in equipment financing from Trinity Capital to expand manufacturing for its first large-scale factory. The company's strategy relies on using widely proven equipment from other industries, which allowed it to secure non-dilutive, lower-cost financing. This funding adds to over $600 million raised previously and will support the production of 100 MW electrolyzers, with the factory aiming for full production volume of 1.2 gigawatts per year by 2025.

summary: Wipro, a leading technology services company, embarked on a journey to transform its business intelligence capabilities by adopting Microsoft Azure Data Lake. The implementation has resulted in streamlined operations, nearly 50 interactive dashboards, and enhanced security, setting the stage for further advancements in predictive analytics and AI integration with Microsoft Fabric.

title: How Stitch Fix Is Using Generative AI To Help Us Dress Better
summary: Stitch Fix is leveraging generative AI to enhance its personalized styling service by interpreting vast amounts of customer feedback and streamlining internal processes. The company uses AI to create clothing recommendations for human stylists, generate ad copy and product descriptions, and automatically style outfits, demonstrating a balance between automation and human expertise. This approach allows AI to handle repetitive tasks, freeing up human stylists for more creative and relationship-building activities.

title: Oracle Stock Jumps 14% as Large Customer Contracts Boost Earnings—Key Level to Watch
summary: Oracle shares surged over 14% in after-hours trading following better-than-expected fiscal third-quarter earnings and strong current-quarter guidance. The company's cloud services segment saw significant growth due to large new cloud infrastructure contracts and high demand for its AI servers. Analysts are watching a key technical level at $127.50, which could turn into support after the earnings-driven breakout.

title: AMD CEO Lisa Su Talks the Invisible Role of A.I. Chips in Oscar-Winning Films
summary: AMD CEO Lisa Su highlighted the significant role of A.I. chips in the production of Oscar-winning animated films at SXSW, noting how they drastically accelerate rendering times. She explained that AMD's hardware is used by partners like Pixar and Wētā FX, enabling sophisticated visual effects that were previously far more time-consuming. The executive VFX producer David Conley also emphasized the critical partnership with companies like AMD for the future of filmmaking, especially with the integration of real-time processing and A.I.

title: Inverse/Leveraged Magnificent Seven ETFs Hit the Market
summary: Roundhill Investments has launched two new ETFs focusing on the "Magnificent Seven" tech stocks: the Roundhill Daily 2X Long Magnificent Seven ETF (MAGX) and the Roundhill Daily Inverse Magnificent Seven ETF (MAGQ). MAGX offers 2x leveraged daily exposure to the Magnificent Seven, while MAGQ provides inverse (-1X) daily exposure. These funds cater to investors looking to capitalize on both potential gains and losses of these influential tech giants, which significantly impact the S&P 500 and are highly valued, indicating a need for both bullish and bearish investment options.

title: The Apple Effect: Magic Leap Founder’s Previous Company Launches App on Vision Pro
summary: Stryker's Mako, a robotic surgery group initially founded by Magic Leap's founder Rony Abovitz, has launched its myMako app on Apple Vision Pro. This move highlights "The Apple Effect" where Apple's market influence draws companies into specific product categories. The article compares Vision Pro's appeal to Magic Leap's earlier struggles and notes how Apple's stability and ecosystem are encouraging XR-adjacent companies to adopt its platform.

title: Will Warren Buffett Keep Selling Apple?
summary: Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway recently reduced its stake in Apple, leading to speculation about whether further sales will occur. This article explores Buffett's history with Apple, current challenges facing the tech giant such as declining sales in China and competitive pressures, and the potential market reaction to Berkshire's next 13F filing. Analysts offer differing views on Apple's future, particularly with the upcoming integration of AI.

title: IBM Stock Gains After Cuts to Marketing and Communications Staff—Key Level To Watch
summary: IBM shares saw gains after the company announced job cuts in its marketing and communications division, part of a "workforce rebalancing" to prioritize AI and hybrid cloud skills. This move aligns with other major tech companies reducing staff amid macroeconomic uncertainties. Investors are closely watching the $206.22 level, which represents IBM's all-time high, as a potential resistance point for the stock.

title: Should SPDR Portfolio S&P 500 Value ETF (SPYV) Be on Your Investing Radar?
summary: The article analyzes the SPDR Portfolio S&P 500 Value ETF (SPYV), a passively managed fund tracking the Large Cap Value segment of the US equity market. It highlights SPYV's low expense ratio, sector allocation (heaviest in Financials), and top holdings including Microsoft, Meta Platforms, and Amazon. The ETF has performed well, gaining 5.34% year-to-date and 28.13% over the past year, and holds a Zacks ETF Rank of 1 (Strong Buy).

title: Microsoft, P&G, Unilever and Walmart among 239 companies to miss net-zero deadline
summary: The Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) has reclassified 239 companies, including Microsoft, P&G, Unilever, and Walmart, as "commitment removed" for net-zero goals because they failed to submit science-based targets for validation within the 24-month deadline. A significant obstacle for these companies is the difficulty in reducing Scope 3 emissions, which relate to indirect emissions from customers and supply chains. Despite the reclassification, these major corporations maintain that they are continuing to pursue aggressive emissions reduction targets and are in various stages of reviewing or updating their strategies to align with SBTi standards, with many still holding near-term validated targets.

title: Oracle unveils $10B data center expansion plan
summary: Oracle announced plans to spend $10 billion in 2025 to expand its data center capacity due to exceptionally high demand for its cloud network. CEO Safra Catz and CTO Larry Ellison highlighted the scale of these new facilities, with one U.S. AI data center capable of housing eight Boeing 747s. This expansion positions Oracle alongside other tech giants in hyperscaler data center construction, despite ongoing industry challenges like supply chain issues and lengthened buildout timelines.

title: Trade Alert: Bill Baruch sells Arm Holdings, buys Phillips 66 and buys more Southern Copper
summary: Bill Baruch, founder of Blue Line Capital, discussed his latest portfolio adjustments on CNBC's 'Halftime Report'. He has sold his position in Arm Holdings, purchased Phillips 66, and increased his holdings in Southern Copper. This indicates a shift in his investment strategy across different sectors.

title: Grief Tech And Digital Immortality: How Far Would You Go?
summary: This article explores the emerging field of "grief tech" and digital immortality, where AI is used to create virtual versions of deceased loved ones. It discusses various applications, from VR reunions and virtual humans to AI-powered chatbots, examining both the potential comfort these technologies offer and the ethical dilemmas they pose, including whether they hinder the grieving process or raise questions about consent and ownership of digital personas.

title: Markets Showing Signs of Bubble on Big Tech, Crypto Surge, BofA’s Hartnett Says
summary: Bank of America’s Chief Investment Strategist Michael Hartnett believes that the current market surge in "Magnificent Seven" tech stocks and cryptocurrencies exhibits characteristics of a bubble. He points to re-accelerating inflation, soft growth, and the narrowness of gaining assets as signs of a "bubble mentality."

title: Democratic ETF outpaces Republican peer on Big Tech bets
summary: An exchange-traded fund tracking Democratic lawmakers' stock trades has significantly outperformed a Republican-oriented fund since its launch last year, driven by strategic investments in megacap technology companies like Nvidia and Microsoft. The Democratic ETF, called NANC, has surged nearly 35%, benefiting from its tilt towards growth stocks, while the Republican ETF, KRUZ, which favors energy and value stocks, gained 18.1%. This performance gap highlights the differing investment strategies based on political affiliations and coincides with growing scrutiny over congressional stock trading.

title: Eos, ESS Inc and Energy Vault narrow losses and lower costs on long ‘path to profitability’
summary: Eos Energy Enterprises, ESS Inc, and Energy Vault, three non-lithium energy storage companies that went public via SPAC mergers, have reported improved revenues and narrowed losses for Q3 2023 and full-year 2023. Despite these financial improvements and operational milestones, none have provided a timeline for achieving sequential profitability, and their stock prices remain significantly below their initial listing values. The article notes that all three companies are focusing on cost reductions and strategic partnerships to move towards profitability.

title: GSA’s TOTAL BPA Streamlines Federal Modernization
summary: The article discusses how the GSA's TOTAL Blanket Purchase Agreement (BPA) helps federal agencies accelerate digital modernization and improve mission outcomes. This streamlined approach offers expertise, speed, and longevity, allowing agencies to partner with GSA and industry vendors like ICF without a lengthy RFP process. The TOTAL BPA is presented as a valuable one-stop-shop for effective federal modernization efforts.

title: Oracle Adds New GenAI Features to Cloud Applications and Expands Microsoft Partnership
summary: Oracle has announced new generative AI features for its Fusion Cloud Applications Suite, designed to enhance employee and customer experiences by leveraging AI within its software-as-a-service applications. Additionally, Oracle is expanding its partnership with Microsoft by making Oracle Database@Azure available in more regions, including its debut in Europe, to meet increasing demand for its cloud products and services, which constitute a significant portion of its revenue.

title: Data management trends: GenAI, governance and lakehouses
summary: The article discusses the top data management trends for 2024, highlighting generative AI, data governance, observability, and the shift towards data lakehouses. It explains how generative AI is being integrated into data platforms to simplify tasks and how data lakehouses are gaining momentum for analytics. The piece also emphasizes the increasing importance of data governance and observability for security, privacy, and accuracy, even as investment funding for emerging vendors slows down.

title: VGT ETF: High Growth, High Concentration (NYSEARCA:VGT)
summary: Vanguard's Information Technology ETF (VGT) has demonstrated strong historical returns, achieving a 48.3% return over the past year and an average annual return of 20% over the last decade. However, the fund is highly concentrated, with Microsoft and Apple accounting for nearly 41% of its investments. VGT offers a low dividend yield of 0.6%, making it less appealing for investors prioritizing income.

title: Apple Highlights Stryker, an NJIT Alum's Medical Tech Group, for VisionPro App
summary: Apple has recognized Stryker Corp., a medical technology company led by NJIT alumnus Robert Cohen, for its innovative MyMako app utilizing the new VisionPro mixed-reality headset. This app allows surgeons to plan and simulate robot-assisted knee replacement operations in 3D, enhancing surgical planning, in-operation information access, and resident training. Cohen envisions future integration of AI to further optimize implant selection and placement based on patient data within this mixed-reality framework.

title: Nasdaq listing is a strategic move aimed at bringing value to Noventiq: CEO Hervé Tessler
summary: Noventiq CEO Hervé Tessler discusses the company's strategic move to list on Nasdaq from the London Stock Exchange, highlighting the benefits of increased access to capital and enhanced brand prestige. He emphasizes Noventiq's strong presence in emerging markets, its partnerships with tech giants like Microsoft and AWS, and its focus on digital transformation, cybersecurity, and AI solutions. Tessler also addresses challenges like navigating diverse global regulations and the imperative for continuous innovation in the rapidly evolving technology sector.

title: Who is Jeff McMillan? Morgan Stanley’s First Head of AI
summary: Morgan Stanley has appointed Jeff McMillan as its first Head of AI, a strategic move to coordinate the firm's AI strategy and capitalize on AI opportunities in digital finance. McMillan, previously Chief Analytics and Data Officer, will work with business units to integrate AI, overseeing projects like the GPT-4 chatbot rollout for bankers. This appointment underscores Morgan Stanley's commitment to AI, projecting significant growth in AI power demand and exploring its positive impacts, including sustainability.

title: 2026 Global Market Outlook: Minds, machines, and market shifts
summary: T. Rowe Price's 2026 Global Market Outlook emphasizes the transformative power of AI, while also highlighting the persistent challenges of valuation, inflation, and geopolitical uncertainty. The outlook suggests investors balance exposure to AI leaders with opportunities in cyclical and international markets, requiring agility and a global perspective. It details prospects across economic, equity, fixed income, private, and Chinese markets, along with asset allocation strategies.

title: NVIDIA Blackwell Platform Arrives to Power a New Era of Computing
summary: NVIDIA has announced the Blackwell platform, a new GPU architecture designed to power the next generation of AI and accelerated computing. The Blackwell platform promises to enable real-time generative AI on trillion-parameter models with significantly reduced cost and energy consumption compared to its predecessor. Major cloud providers and AI companies, including Amazon Web Services, Google, Meta, Microsoft, OpenAI, Oracle, Tesla, and xAI, are expected to adopt Blackwell.

title: Top 10 Enterprise Data Management Companies | Best Accuracy and Security
summary: This article identifies and profiles the top 10 Enterprise Data Management (EDM) companies, highlighting their solutions, market presence, and recent developments. It also provides an overview of the EDM market, including its drivers and projected growth from USD 97.5 billion in 2023 to USD 281.9 billion by 2033. The featured companies include industry giants like IBM, SAP, Oracle, SAS, Informatica, Microsoft, Intel, Toshiba, Teradata, and AWS, each playing a significant role in helping organizations manage and leverage their data effectively.

title: Blackwell: Nvidia's GPU architecture to power new generation of trillion-parameter generative AI models
summary: Nvidia has unveiled its new Blackwell GPU architecture, designed to power trillion-parameter generative AI models with significantly reduced cost and power consumption compared to previous generations. This architecture introduces six transformative technologies, including a custom manufacturing process and enhanced networking capabilities, promising breakthroughs across various advanced computing domains. Blackwell will be available through cloud providers and third-party server manufacturers, enabling a new era of large-scale AI deployment.

title: COLUMN: Live Nation's exploitative monopoly must end
summary: This column argues that Live Nation Entertainment's monopolistic control over concert ticketing, primarily through Ticketmaster, leads to exploitative practices for consumers. The author recounts personal negative experiences with the "Verified Fan" system for popular tours and details how Ticketmaster's practices, such as high fees, controversial insurance policies, and anti-competitive agreements with venues, restrict competition and harm fans. The article calls for the breakup of Live Nation Entertainment to foster a more equitable ticketing market.

title: Climb Takes On Big Disties with Emerging Vendor Focus
summary: Climb Global Solutions is challenging large distributors by focusing on incubating emerging technology brands that are underserved by broadline distribution. The company, led by CEO Dale Foster, has strategically acquired several European distributors and aims to provide value to emerging vendors that larger distributors, focused on established brands like Cisco and Microsoft, cannot. Climb plans further acquisitions and EMEA expansion, asserting that the market for emerging vendors is radically underserved.

title: The Next Big Theme: March 2024
summary: This article highlights key trends and developments across several transformative themes in March 2024, including advancements in humanoid robotics, continued growth in electric vehicle sales despite headwinds, breakthroughs in generative AI for audio and video, the scaling up of the global hydrogen industry, and AI-driven innovation in telemedicine and digital health. It also addresses the intensification of ransomware attacks and fortifying cybersecurity defenses. The article concludes by presenting performance and sales growth expectations for these themes, referencing corresponding ETFs.

title: NVIDIA, Huang Win Top Honors in Innovation, Engineering
summary: NVIDIA has been named the world's most innovative company by Fast Company magazine, recognizing its transformative work in putting AI to use across various industries. This accolade follows NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang's induction into the U.S. National Academy of Engineering for his contributions to high-powered graphics processing units and fueling the AI revolution. Leaders from Microsoft, Stanford University, and TSMC have praised Huang's visionary leadership and enduring impact on computing and AI.

title: Mind Meld: Brain-Computer Interfaces Unlock the Future (2024 and Beyond!)
summary: This article explores the rapidly advancing field of Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCIs), detailing their evolution from early EEG-based systems to modern, embedded devices like those being developed by Neuralink. It highlights current applications in healthcare for restoring motor function and communication, as well as in gaming and cognitive enhancement. The author also addresses significant challenges including technical limitations, ethical concerns around privacy and consent, and issues of accessibility and affordability, while predicting a future where BCIs are smaller, more integrated, and significantly amplify human capabilities.

title: List Joins lululemon Board of Directors
summary: Teri List, a Northern Michigan University alumna, has been appointed to the lululemon athletica inc. Board of Directors. She brings extensive experience from her previous roles at Gap Inc., DICK'S Sporting Goods, and Kraft Food Group, and currently serves on the boards of Microsoft, Visa, and Danaher Corporation. List expressed enthusiasm for supporting lululemon's global expansion and guest experience, while lululemon's board chair highlighted her impressive business leadership and insights.

title: LIBERTY LATIN AMERICA ANNOUNCES LAUNCH OF DIRECT ROUTING SERVICE FOR MICROSOFT TEAMS PHONE ACROSS CENTRAL AMERICA AND THE CARIBBEAN
summary: Liberty Latin America has launched its Direct Routing service for Microsoft Teams Phone, offering seamless integration with its telephony network and local dialing across Central America and the Caribbean. This service allows businesses to make and receive calls directly through Teams, eliminating traditional telephony systems and enhancing collaboration. It provides flexibility, scalability, enhanced mobility, reliable connectivity, and dedicated 24/7 support.

title: IPO winter ending? Astera Labs and Reddit surge in stock trading debuts
summary: Astera Labs and Reddit both experienced successful stock trading debuts, signaling a potential end to the "IPO winter." Astera Labs, a chip supplier for cloud data centers, exceeded expectations in its IPO, raising $712.8 million, with shares surging over 72% on the Nasdaq. Reddit also saw its shares jump 38% on the NYSE, marking a significant milestone for a social media company's public offering since 2019.

title: Google, Microsoft, and Nucor partner for new energy tech PPAs
summary: Google, Microsoft, and Nucor Corporation are collaborating to develop and fund early-stage clean energy projects, including advanced nuclear, geothermal, and long-duration energy storage. They aim to reduce risk for developers by aggregating demand and designing new commercial models to bring these technologies online by the early 2030s. The companies have issued an RFI for potential projects in several US regions, with an initial focus on the US to prove the demand aggregation and procurement model for these advanced technologies.

title: No Jitter Midroll: ServiceNow’s Washington D.C. Platform Release Includes New Generative AI-based Capabilities
summary: ServiceNow has announced new generative AI capabilities in its Washington D.C. platform release, integrating Gen AI into its Virtual Agent Designer and Dynamic Translation product. The company aims to offer customers a choice of AI models, including its own purpose-built models and partnerships with OpenAI and Google Cloud. These enhancements are designed to improve productivity, reduce costs, and accelerate the time to value for customers.

title: ServiceNow Washington, DC Release Goes Deep On AI, GenAI
summary: ServiceNow has released its Now Platform Washington, D.C. update, heavily featuring AI and generative AI to boost intelligent automation and simplify workflows. The release introduces Workflow Studio for simplified automation and enhanced Platform Analytics for better performance tracking. It also includes new Sales and Order Management and Security Posture Control tools, all underpinned by advanced GenAI integrations.

title: Meta, Microsoft, X and Match join Epic Games' battle against Apple
summary: Meta Platforms, Microsoft, X, and Match Group have joined Epic Games in accusing Apple of violating a court-ordered injunction regarding payments in its App Store. The companies claim Apple is in "clear violation" by making it difficult for developers to direct consumers to alternative, cheaper payment methods for digital content. Apple, however, maintains it has fully complied with the injunction, arguing it protects consumers and its ecosystem.

title: Microsoft, Google, Nucor partner on initiative to spur emerging 24/7 clean power technologies
summary: Microsoft, Google, and Nucor have launched the Advanced Clean Electricity initiative to accelerate the development and deployment of reliable, low- or zero-carbon electricity generation technologies like advanced nuclear, next-generation geothermal, and long-duration energy storage. The initiative aims for widespread commercial deployment by the early 2030s and aggregates the three companies' demand for clean electricity to spur first-of-a-kind and early commercial projects. Projects must be located in the U.S., with a preference for the PJM region, and meet specific evaluation criteria, including a potential capacity factor above 50% and project capacity above 50 MW.

title: Impact Shares YWCA Women’s Empowerment ETF (WOMN) Reaches $50M in Assets Under Management
summary: The Impact Shares YWCA Women’s Empowerment ETF ($WOMN) has surpassed $50 million in Assets Under Management (AUM), demonstrating investor interest in socially conscious funds. This ETF provides broad market exposure to U.S. companies promoting gender equity, with all net advisory profits donated to the YWCA to support its mission. The partnership between Impact Shares, Tidal Financial Group, and the YWCA highlights an innovative approach to aligning financial returns with social impact.

title: The best RMM software in 2025 to manage your corporate network
summary: This article reviews the best Remote Monitoring and Management (RMM) software packages for 2025, detailing their features, pros, and cons. It highlights how RMM tools centralize IT support, enable automation, and are crucial for managed service providers (MSPs). The article provides in-depth analysis of top contenders like NinjaOne, N-able N-sight, ManageEngine RMM Central, Site24x7 MSP Edition, Barracuda RMM, and Syncro, guiding businesses and MSPs in choosing the most effective solution for their needs.

title: Clean Electricity: Microsoft, Google and Nucor Join Forces
summary: Microsoft, Google, and Nucor are collaborating to overcome barriers in developing clean electricity technologies. They plan to establish new business models and aggregate their demand to accelerate first-of-a-kind projects such as advanced nuclear, next-generation geothermal, clean hydrogen, and long-duration energy storage. The companies are issuing an RFI for potential projects in the US, aiming to bring clear customer voice to policymakers and develop new tariff structures.

title: Curious Serpens’ FalseFont Backdoor: Technical Analysis, Detection and Prevention
summary: This article provides a technical analysis of FalseFont, a new backdoor developed by the suspected Iranian-affiliated threat actor "Curious Serpens" (aka Peach Sandstorm). FalseFont targets job applicants in the aerospace and defense industries by mimicking legitimate HR software. The article details the backdoor's architecture, functionality, persistence mechanisms, dual communication methods via direct API calls and SignalR, and its credential theft capabilities, while also explaining how Palo Alto Network's Cortex XDR platform can detect and prevent this malware.

title: DOJ faces tough road in Apple antitrust lawsuit
summary: The Department of Justice's antitrust lawsuit against Apple faces significant challenges, despite drawing parallels to the successful Microsoft case two decades ago. Antitrust specialists highlight key differences and legal precedents that could make it difficult for the DOJ to prove Apple's monopolistic conduct and force product redesigns. Apple is expected to argue that its "walled-garden" approach benefits consumers and that the government's market definition is flawed.

title: Get to know QQQ: Charting 25 years of performance
summary: The article celebrates 25 years of the Invesco QQQ ETF, tracing its evolution from its launch in 1999 to becoming one of the largest ETFs today. It highlights key milestones such as reaching significant assets under management (AUM), changes in sponsorship and naming, and its consistent outperformance compared to the S&P 500. QQQ is presented as a proven way for investors to gain exposure to highly innovative, non-financial companies listed on the Nasdaq-100 Index.

title: Seeking a Growth ETF with Strong Returns? Check Out ILCG
summary: The iShares Morningstar Growth ETF (ILCG) is highlighted as a strong option for investors seeking growth, offering diversified exposure to 389 top U.S. large- and mid-cap growth stocks. The article emphasizes its long track record of strong returns, low expense ratio of 0.04%, and consistent double-digit annualized returns since its inception in 2004. Despite slightly underperforming the S&P 500 over three years, ILCG has outperformed it over five and ten-year periods, making it a reliable, cost-effective long-term investment.

title: Wait, Did Europe Really Outperform the U.S. over the Last Three Years?
summary: This article challenges the common perception that European equities perpetually lag behind their U.S. counterparts. It highlights how a selection of 11 European "GRANOLAS" companies have delivered returns surprisingly similar to the U.S. Magnificent 7 over the past three years. Additionally, the WisdomTree Europe Hedged Equity Fund (HEDJ) has demonstrated significant outperformance against the S&P 500 and comparable European ETFs, attributed to its stock selection process, dividend yield weighting, and exporter tilt, all while trading at a valuation discount.

title: How to invest in ChatGPT stock?
summary: This article explains that direct investment in ChatGPT stock is not possible as its developer, OpenAI, is not publicly traded. Instead, it suggests investing in publicly traded companies heavily involved in AI technology, such as Microsoft (MSFT), NVIDIA (NVDA), Perion Network (PERI), and C3.ai (AI). The article details each company's relevance to AI and provides an investment strategy for AI stocks, emphasizing diversification and monitoring financial health.

title: FTEC: Concentration Increases Volatility (NYSEARCA:FTEC)
summary: The Fidelity MSCI Information Technology Index ETF (FTEC) offers strong tech exposure, performing similarly to VGT. However, 45% of its assets are concentrated in Microsoft, Apple, and NVIDIA, which could lead to increased volatility despite a projected 7% upside by year-end 2024. The author, Ricardo Fernandez, highlights the importance of an investor's goals and definition of "tech" when choosing an ETF.

title: The World’s Craziest Data Centres
summary: This article explores some of the most unusual and innovative locations for data centres around the world, highlighting how they adapt to extreme environments and leverage natural resources for cooling and sustainability. Examples include data centres built in disused paper mills, floating on barges, submerged underwater, nestled in Arctic cold, within former military bunkers, and even beneath churches. These unconventional approaches demonstrate creative solutions to the ever-increasing demand for data storage and processing.

title: NYSE Welcomes Destiny Tech100 (DXYZ), Pioneering Access to Tech Innovation
summary: Destiny Tech100 (DXYZ) commenced trading on the NYSE on March 26, 2024, offering investors access to leading private tech companies like SpaceX and OpenAI. The stock debuted at $8.25, closing at $9.00, providing liquidity and public market protections for private market opportunities. The Tech100 is designed as a portfolio of 100 top private technology firms, making these investments more accessible to everyday investors.

title: Zoom spreads AI across collaboration services
summary: Zoom has launched Workplace, an AI-powered collaboration hub that integrates chat, phone, video, and email services, including its AI Companion at no extra cost. This move positions Zoom to compete with rivals like Microsoft and Google, which charge for similar AI services, and addresses enterprise concerns about data control and privacy in AI applications. The company also announced improvements to its video conferencing platform and a partnership with Avaya to expand its reach.

title: A new product allows 5x leveraged bets on the Magnificent Seven. Traders should be wary.
summary: A new exchange-traded product allows investors to make 5x leveraged bets on the Magnificent Seven group of stocks, raising concerns among analysts. While levered exchange-traded products are gaining popularity, traders are warned about the significant risks associated with such highly leveraged instruments. ETF analyst Todd Sohn from Strategas Securities notes that this product appears to be the most heavily levered available in any developed market.

title: Take-Two Buys Gearbox, Company Behind The Borderlands Franchise, From Embracer For $460 Million
summary: Take-Two Interactive Software has acquired Gearbox Entertainment, known for the Borderlands franchise, from Embracer in an all-stock deal valued at $460 million. This acquisition deepens Take-Two's relationship with Gearbox, giving it full ownership of popular IPs like Borderlands and Tiny Tina's Wonderlands. Randy Pitchford will continue to lead Gearbox as a studio within Take-Two, with several new projects and sequels already in development.

title: Major Shifts in Store for Cybersecurity Landscape by 2028
summary: Gartner's 2024 cybersecurity predictions highlight significant shifts including the impact of GenAI on the skills gap, the increasing personal legal exposure for cybersecurity leaders, and the growing financial burden of combating misinformation. By 2028, GenAI could eliminate the need for specialized education in 50% of entry-level cybersecurity roles, and enterprise spending on fighting misinformation is projected to exceed $500 billion. The predictions emphasize the evolving nature of cybersecurity, with a focus on both technological advancements and the human element.

title: SKT celebrates 40 years with new emblem, commitment to AI
summary: SKT unveiled a new company emblem to celebrate its 40th anniversary, reaffirming its commitment to the AI business. CEO Ryu Young-sang emphasized the company's "DNA" of overcoming challenges and aims for SKT to transform into a global AI company. Having evolved from a mobile telecom service provider to a multifaceted technology company, SKT plans to leverage its global AI association (GTAA) to expand its presence in the burgeoning global AI industry.

title: These Growth Funds Continued to Shine in Q1 2024
summary: Growth equity funds, especially those with exposure to AI-related stocks, continued their strong performance in Q1 2024, significantly outperforming value funds. While large-cap growth led the way, small- and mid-cap growth funds also fared well. International growth funds also saw gains, although they lagged behind their US counterparts.

title: ED 24-02: Mitigating the Significant Risk from Nation-State Compromise of Microsoft Corporate Email System
summary: CISA Emergency Directive ED 24-02 addresses the significant risk posed by the Midnight Blizzard nation-state actor's compromise of Microsoft corporate email accounts, which exfiltrated correspondence from Federal Civilian Executive Branch agencies. The directive mandates agencies to analyze compromised email content, reset credentials, and secure Microsoft Azure accounts by specific deadlines. CISA will provide support and monitor compliance to mitigate the threat.

title: Cybersecurity Faces Transformation from Generative AI
summary: Generative AI presents a double-edged sword for cybersecurity, simultaneously enabling more sophisticated cyberattacks and providing powerful tools for defense. Despite economic headwinds, global cybersecurity spending is projected to grow significantly, driven by the escalating threat landscape and the need to integrate AI-powered defenses. This transformation is expected to create opportunities for market consolidation and continued growth in the cybersecurity sector, appealing to investors looking beyond obvious AI beneficiaries.

title: The Role of AI in Driving Digital Transformation
summary: This article explores the indispensable role of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in driving digital transformation across various sectors. It highlights how AI offers numerous benefits, from process automation and personalized customer experiences to advanced data analytics and enhanced customer support, emphasizing that businesses leveraging AI effectively will thrive and lead innovation. The piece also delves into future applications of AI in hyper-personalization, streamlined operations, and sustainable solutions.

title: How AI-Enabled Tractor Supply Is Preparing Its IT Infrastructure for the Future
summary: Tractor Supply is aggressively integrating AI across its enterprise, from real-time inventory monitoring to customer service and associate support, necessitating a robust IT infrastructure. The company partners with Microsoft Azure for data housing and emphasizes strong data governance and a skilled workforce to manage ethical AI use and ensure data quality. These efforts are geared toward delivering legendary customer service and preparing for future technological advancements and growth.

title: Today’s top business headlines: GE's breakup, Microsoft Teams cut from Office, recalled car fire risks
summary: This article covers major business news including General Electric's breakup into three public companies, Microsoft's decision to unbundle Teams from Office due to regulatory pressure, ongoing fire risks with recalled Hyundai and Kia vehicles, NASA's citizen science projects for the upcoming solar eclipse, and SLB's recent $8 billion acquisition of ChampionX. These headlines highlight significant shifts in corporate structures, regulatory impacts on tech giants, public safety concerns in the auto industry, and consolidation trends in the energy sector.

title: Ark Invest BTC ETF Bleeding Severely, Surpassing GBTC ETF Outflow
summary: Ark Invest's ARKB Bitcoin spot ETF experienced significant outflows, totaling $88 million on April 2, 2024, surpassing the $82 million outflow from Grayscale's GBTC ETF on the same day. This occurred amidst a decline in Bitcoin's trading price. While ARKB and GBTC face outflows, other ETFs like BlackRock's IBIT are still showing inflows, indicating a mixed performance for Bitcoin ETFs.

title: Johnson & Johnson CIO says employee upskilling is key to transforming health care
summary: Johnson & Johnson CIO Jim Swanson emphasizes that upskilling employees with "bilingual" skills—combining domain expertise with technological knowledge—is crucial for transforming healthcare and driving innovation, not just incremental improvements. This strategy, which includes comprehensive training on AI, augmented reality, and data fundamentals, aims to integrate technology throughout the company's 130,000-person workforce. Swanson believes this approach helps reimagine processes from R&D to finance, leading to significant business value, such as a potential $1.5 billion financial improvement through better forecasting accuracy.

title: The Rise of FinOps and GreenOps
summary: The article introduces FinOps and GreenOps as crucial methodologies for optimizing cloud usage in terms of both cost and environmental sustainability. It explains how FinOps acts as a financial advisor for cloud spending, ensuring cost transparency, right-sizing resources, and governance, while GreenOps focuses on reducing the environmental impact by optimizing resource utilization, selecting eco-friendly resources, and leveraging renewable energy. The piece emphasizes that these two approaches, working together, are essential for responsible cloud adoption and creating a brighter, greener future.

title: Erosion in the rule of law creates potential corporate governance gaps & increases risks for management
summary: The erosion of the rule of law globally, especially with numerous elections planned for this year, poses significant risk exposure for organizations. This trend complicates the existing risk landscape for Chief Legal Officers and General Counsels, who must integrate political considerations into their legal assessments to avoid underestimating risks or missing opportunities. Companies need to adopt integrated approaches, build scenarios, and develop proactive plans to navigate these evolving complexities and ensure sustainability.

title: Winners of the 2024 IoT Evolution Industrial IoT Product of the Year Awards Announced
summary: TMC and Crossfire Media announced the winners of the 2024 IoT Evolution Industrial IoT Product of the Year Award, recognizing the most innovative products and solutions powering the Industrial Internet of Things. The award highlights products influencing efficiency and productivity gains for customers, with nominations based on availability for deployment within the past twelve months. Winning this award provides significant recognition, increased visibility, and marketing opportunities for the recipient companies.

title: Bank of Montreal runs risk calculations twice as fast and at 30% less cost with Azure
summary: Bank of Montreal (BMO) successfully migrated its market risk management platform to Microsoft Azure, achieving significant performance improvements and cost reductions. The bank now runs risk calculations twice as fast and at 30% less cost compared to its previous setup, enabling enhanced risk management capabilities. BMO also plans to scale its core processing capacity significantly and explore further use of AI and machine learning with Azure.

title: How to Find a Great Dividend Fund
summary: This article provides guidance on how investors can find a great dividend fund by categorizing funds into dividend income, dividend growth, and a combination of both, and discussing their associated risks and trade-offs. Morningstar analysts offer insights into why dividend yield should not be the top priority and compare actively managed funds with passive options, ultimately recommending several passively and actively managed dividend funds.

title: Alger Launches 2 Transparent Actively Managed ETFs
summary: Fred Alger Management has launched two new transparent actively managed ETFs: the Alger AI Enablers & Adopters ETF (ALAI) and the Alger Concentrated Equity ETF (CNEQ). ALAI focuses on companies involved with artificial intelligence, while CNEQ invests in large-cap growth companies, with a significant allocation to technology. These additions bring Alger's ETF family to five funds, building on their earlier entry into the ETF market in 2021.

title: HubSpot Acquisition Could Boost Google's Cloud Computing Business
summary: Alphabet (Google's parent company) is reportedly exploring its largest-ever acquisition by potentially buying HubSpot, a major online marketing software company. This strategic move aims to expand Google's presence in the lucrative customer relationship management (CRM) market and leverage its significant cash reserves. The potential deal raises important discussions about regulatory scrutiny, especially given the current antitrust environment under the Biden administration, and could significantly impact the competitive landscape for CRM providers like Salesforce and Microsoft.

title: Alger Concentrated Equity ETF Holdings
summary: This article details the holdings of the Alger Concentrated Equity ETF (CNEQ), which was created on April 5, 2024. The ETF focuses on large-cap companies with high growth potential, maintaining a concentrated portfolio of no more than 30 stocks. The reported holdings include major technology companies like NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Amazon, alongside others across various sectors.

title: If I Could Only Buy and Hold 1 Vanguard ETF For the Next 5 Years, This Would Be My Top Pick
summary: The article recommends the Vanguard Large-Cap ETF (VV) as a top choice for a buy-and-hold strategy for the next five years due to its low expense ratio, focus on U.S. large-cap stocks like Microsoft, Apple, and Nvidia, and its ability to provide broad diversification. It highlights the ETF's simplicity and stability, making it easier for investors to hold through market volatility compared to individual stocks or more specialized thematic ETFs. The author also notes the subtle differences and near-identical returns between VV and the Vanguard S&P 500 ETF, with a slight preference for VV.

title: Westcon-Comstor Brings AudioCodes Live for Microsoft Teams to EMEA
summary: Westcon-Comstor will distribute AudioCodes' Live Platform for Microsoft Teams to partners across EMEA, enhancing UCaaS and CCaaS offerings. This white-labelled platform, hosted by AudioCodes and managed by Westcon in Microsoft Azure, provides comprehensive calling, contact center, and recording capabilities for Microsoft Teams. The collaboration aims to empower channel partners to boost revenues by offering a hosted voice solution and expanding the reach of AudioCodes' Microsoft Teams experience.

title: Fidelity Hedged Equity ETF Holdings
summary: The Fidelity Hedged Equity ETF (FHEQ), established on April 9, 2024, is an actively managed ETF focusing on large-cap equity. It holds 159 stocks, with a total of $865.43 million in assets under management. The fund aims for capital appreciation through quantitative analysis and uses put options for downside protection.

title: Google introduces new Arm-based AI chip for data centers
summary: Google has announced its new custom-designed Arm-based AI chips, called Axion Processors, for data centers. These processors are designed to offer better performance and energy efficiency compared to x86 chips and general-purpose Arm chips. The Axion Processors will be available to Google Cloud customers later this year and are already in use in some of Google's own services.

title: Prevention through Design (PtD) Award
summary: The Prevention through Design (PtD) Award, presented by NIOSH and partners, recognizes individuals, teams, and organizations for eliminating or reducing hazards through design efforts or contributing to the body of knowledge enabling PtD solutions. Nominations are due the first weekday of March and highlight successful implementations of PtD principles, with recent winners including Bruce Main and Jacobs Solutions in 2024. The article details the award criteria, nomination process, and provides examples of past awardees and honorable mentions, showcasing diverse PtD applications.

title: Suzuki embraces Azure OpenAI Service, supercharges AI use with five apps, and sparks ideas for AI in business
summary: Suzuki Motor Corporation is rapidly adopting generative AI through the Azure OpenAI Service to drive new initiatives and improve efficiency. The company has developed five unique multilingual web applications, including NAGI and NAMI, to expand AI usage across various departments. Suzuki aims to streamline operations, reduce manual tasks by 80%, and leverage AI to overcome challenges in a rapidly changing automotive industry.

title: Adobe leverages Microsoft Azure to streamline the customer experience, harnessing the power of connected cloud services.
summary: The partnership between Adobe and Microsoft integrates Adobe’s enterprise solutions with Microsoft’s cloud services, aiming to improve customer experiences and drive AI transformation. This collaboration focuses on streamlining cloud infrastructure, enhancing data management, and accelerating business outcomes through seamless integrations and innovative AI capabilities. The alliance has shown significant economic impact, including a 251% ROI over three years and improved productivity for IT, security, and marketing teams.

title: Alger AI Enablers & Adopters ETF
summary: This article provides a detailed profile of the Alger AI Enablers & Adopters ETF (ALAI), including its stock quote, holdings, expenses, performance, and ESG scores. It highlights ALAI's focus on technology equities, its active management strategy, and its top holdings in major tech companies like NVIDIA, Alphabet, and Amazon. The ETF has shown strong performance with a 1-year return of 51.29% and has attracted significant net flows, indicating growing interest in AI-focused investments.

title: Pixelworks Brings New Mobile Gaming Experience to "Diablo Immortal", a Co-developed Game by Blizzard Entertainment and NetEase
summary: Pixelworks announced that "Diablo Immortal," co-developed by Blizzard Entertainment and NetEase, has integrated its IRX Rendering Accelerator SDK to deliver a 120fps visual experience with low power consumption. This collaboration aims to provide mobile gamers with an immersive, PC-like gaming experience by overcoming mobile platform limitations through advanced visual processing techniques.

title: Adobe Is Buying Videos for $3 Per Minute to Build AI Model
summary: Adobe (ADBE) is actively procuring videos to develop its artificial intelligence text-to-video generator, aiming to compete with technologies like OpenAI's Sora. The company is offering artists $120 to submit videos depicting everyday actions and emotions for AI training purposes. This initiative highlights Adobe's strategy to enhance its AI capabilities in the face of competitive pressure.

title: Apple's New Jersey store workers file petition for unionization
summary: Workers at an Apple store in Short Hills, New Jersey, have filed for union representation with the Communications Workers of America. This move is part of a broader unionization push across various companies in corporate America, including Starbucks, Amazon.com, and Microsoft, where employees are seeking better working conditions. Apple stated that it offers top-tier pay and comprehensive benefits to its retail teams.

title: Implications of AI for cloud computing companies
summary: The article explores the significant impact of AI on cloud computing companies, noting that while AI has driven much of the equity market's recent gains, particularly for the "magnificent seven" tech companies, the broader economic benefits may take time to materialize. It highlights cloud computing as a key beneficiary, where AI integration can enhance operational efficiency, decision-making, cybersecurity, and personalized services. The piece also introduces the Fidelity Cloud Computing UCITS ETF as a means for investors to gain exposure to this theme.

title: Fidelity Yield Enhanced Equity ETF Holdings
summary: This article details the holdings of the Fidelity Yield Enhanced Equity ETF (FYEE), which was established on April 11, 2024. The fund actively manages a portfolio primarily focused on large-cap equities, similar to the S&P 500 and Russell 1000, and sells call options to generate income, aiming for current income and potential capital growth. The list provided shows its top holdings include major technology and financial companies such as NVIDIA, Apple, Microsoft, and Amazon.

title: Microsoft says Georgia may be overestimating data center load growth
summary: Microsoft has filed comments with the Georgia Public Service Commission, challenging Georgia Power Company's modeling methods for load growth, arguing they undervalue renewable energy and overestimate data center demand through 2030. The tech giant, which has significant data center operations in Georgia, is concerned that the utility's approach includes speculative projects and relies on a high-end load forecast, potentially leading to excessive and carbon-intensive generation procurement. Microsoft is advocating for greater transparency, a focus on projects with firm commitments, and better integration of renewable energy sources and storage solutions in Georgia Power's resource planning.

title: Creator-Platform Company Spotter Hires Adobe and Microsoft Alum Ivo Manolov as CTO
summary: Spotter, a company providing capital and software to online creators, has appointed Ivo Manolov, an alum of Adobe Systems and Microsoft, as its new Chief Technology Officer. Manolov will lead the development of AI-powered software for YouTubers. This strategic hire underscores Spotter's commitment to enhancing its technology and AI initiatives for creators.

title: Terry Smith – Top 10 Holdings – Latest 13F
summary: This article analyzes Terry Smith's top 10 holdings based on his latest 13F-HR filing as of December 31, 2023. His portfolio has a market value of over $23.8 billion, with 65.29% concentrated in his top ten positions. Microsoft, Meta Platforms, and Stryker Corp are among his largest holdings.

title: Akamai expands cloud services with dedicated GPUs for media workloads
summary: Akamai Technologies Inc. has launched a new industry-optimized cloud service utilizing Nvidia RTX 4000 Ada generation GPUs, specifically designed for media workloads to enhance video encoding, decoding, and processing. This service aims to provide faster and more cost-effective solutions for media providers compared to standard virtual machines, leveraging Akamai's global edge network. Although optimized for media, the service is also capable of supporting other demanding tasks like generative AI training and inference.

title: Arrow Debuts Copilot for Microsoft 365 Services for Partners
