title: 12 advantages and disadvantages of video conferencing
summary: Video conferencing offers numerous benefits, such as increased savings by reducing travel, enhanced employee productivity through remote work flexibility, and valuable features like meeting transcription and translation services. However, it also presents challenges including a lack of personal interaction, potential network connectivity issues, security concerns, and complexities in complying with data governance and regulatory requirements for newly generated content. Organizations must weigh these pros and cons to effectively integrate video conferencing into their operations while addressing privacy and compliance issues.

summary: Morningstar has raised its fair value estimate for Arista Networks (ANET) to $300 per share, up from $270, due to exceptional growth in AI networking environments. summary: Canadian power generator TransAlta is in discussions with multiple hyperscalers about developing data center campuses in Alberta. The company is actively preparing its sites to be "turnkey ready" for data centers and plans to decommission a gas-fired generating unit, potentially repurposing it for future data center-related developments. While the Alberta government supports data center growth, particularly for AI installations, it emphasizes grid reliability, indicating that new data centers may need to secure their own power generation.

The piece highlights the strategic vision behind Delta's intervention and the ongoing efforts to transform Wheels Up into a profitable, well-managed private aviation company.

title: Tech firms fined $10m for downplaying breach impact
summary: Four technology firms — Unisys, Avaya, Check Point Software Technologies, and Mimecast — have been fined a combined $10.6 million by the US SEC for allegedly misleading investors about their exposure to the 2020 SolarWinds data breach. The SEC found that these companies "negligently minimised" the cyber incident in public disclosures, framing risks hypothetically despite knowing they had experienced data exfiltration. This action signals heightened regulatory intolerance for companies downplaying the impact of cybercrimes, emphasizing the importance of transparent disclosure to protect investors.

summary: Amazon, IKEA, and about three dozen other companies are forming an alliance called the Zero Emissions Maritime Buyers Alliance to boost demand for new green e-fuels in ocean shipping. summary: ServiceNow has launched its Now Platform Xanadu release, introducing hundreds of new AI capabilities to enhance productivity, customer agility, and employee experiences. summary: Topcon Healthcare and Microsoft Corporation have partnered to create an AI- and cloud-based healthcare platform aimed at improving healthcare access, cost, and quality. This collaboration focuses on a robotic, rapid, and non-invasive eye scan for pre-screenings of systemic and neurological diseases, combining Microsoft's Nuance Precision Imaging Network with Topcon Harmony. The initiative also includes collaborations with the University of California, San Diego, and the establishment of the Institute for Digital Health.

summary: Morgan Stanley has deployed its second generative AI application, "AI @ Morgan Stanley Debrief," to its financial advisers. This new tool, developed in-house with OpenAI, summarizes video meetings and drafts follow-up emails, aligning with the company's preference for homegrown solutions over external tech provider tools. This follows the successful 2023 rollout of their AI knowledge assistant.

summary: Microsoft's board of directors is advising shareholders to reject a proposal to invest corporate cash in Bitcoin. Microsoft states that its Global Treasury and Investment Services team already evaluates a wide array of potential investments, including cryptocurrencies, and manages its corporate treasury effectively.

summary: This article lists the top 10 highest-paying IT jobs in 2024 according to a Robert Half report, with salaries ranging from approximately $95,000 to over $200,000 annually. title: Cirrus Logic, Intel, and Microsoft Announce Latest Reference Design to Enable “Cool, Quiet, and High Performance” PCs
summary: Cirrus Logic, in collaboration with Intel and Microsoft, has announced a new PC reference design aimed at creating "cool, quiet, and high performance" laptops. This design incorporates Cirrus Logic's high-efficiency power converter, low-power audio codec, and smart amplifiers to reduce heat, extend battery life, enable thinner designs and provide immersive audio. The new platform expands Cirrus Logic's expertise beyond audio components to include power conversion solutions, offering significant benefits for both OEMs and consumers.

title: Cintas Named One of Forbes’ America’s Best Large Employers
summary: Cintas Corporation has been named to Forbes’ list of America’s Best Large Employers of 2024 for the second consecutive year, based on outstanding survey feedback from current and past employees, industry peers, and consumers. title: DULUX Paints by PPG launches Dulux PRO app digital platform for professional painters
summary: DULUX Paints by PPG has launched the Dulux PRO app, a new digital platform designed for professional painters in Canada. This app allows professionals to browse the Dulux product catalog, access job details, and place orders conveniently from their mobile devices or through the website. The launch is part of PPG's commitment to providing innovative products and services to their professional customers, building on previous app launches in the U.S. and Puerto Rico.

title: Perion Network Announces Preliminary Q1 2024 Financial Results
summary: Perion Network (NASDAQ & TASE: PERI) announced preliminary Q1 2024 financial results, expecting $157 million in revenue and $20 million in adjusted EBITDA, primarily due to a decline in Search Advertising activity caused by changes implemented by Microsoft Bing. The company also updated its full-year 2024 guidance to $590-$610 million in revenue and $78-$82 million in adjusted EBITDA, a decrease mainly attributed to Search Advertising. Despite the challenges, Perion raised its share buyback program from $50 million to $75 million, emphasizing the strength of its display advertising segment and confidence in its long-term strategy.

title: The Future of 3D Printing
summary: This article explores the future of 3D printing, highlighting advancements in speed, turnaround time, potential for mass manufacturing, increased productivity, and improved materials. title: Ault Alliance Announces that Sentinum, its Wholly Owned Subsidiary, has Mined 552 Bitcoin in 2024 and 2,894 Bitcoin Since Inception
summary: Ault Alliance announced that its subsidiary Sentinum has mined 552 Bitcoin in 2024 and 2,894 Bitcoin since its inception. The company plans to expand its data center operations, including transforming its Michigan facility into a hyperscale center and exploring additional power in Montana. Ault Alliance also intends to change its name to Hyperscale Data, Inc. and spin off unrelated subsidiaries to focus on AI data-center businesses.

title: Why Aflac's CIO won't ever be first to market with generative AI—but is still finding ways to adopt the technology
summary: Aflac's CIO, Shelia Anderson, emphasizes a conservative yet proactive approach to generative AI, prioritizing guardrails, education, and internal applications before external deployment in 2025. The company is exploring use cases like fraud detection and churn predictions in its Hatch Innovation Lab and leveraging existing partnerships while being cautious about customized solutions and data security. Beyond AI, Anderson is focused on integrating acquisitions, streamlining customer-facing processes, and optimizing cloud migration costs.

title: Digital Transformation Examples | What Is Digital Transformation?
summary: This article from Autodesk explores the concept of digital transformation, defining it as an ongoing process of aligning modern technology with business needs to improve efficiency, customer experience, and innovation. The piece also provides guidance on how to begin a digital transformation and measure its success.

title: Nvidia’s Ascent to Most Valued Company Has Echoes of Dot-Com Boom - WSJ
summary: Nvidia has become the world’s most valuable listed company, driven by demand for its AI chips, drawing comparisons to the dot-com boom of two decades ago when Cisco Systems held a similar position. Nvidia's chips are crucial for the AI boom, enabling the creation of advanced AI systems. Despite the historical parallels, a former Cisco CEO suggests the current situation is different.

title: The 10 Biggest Nvidia News Stories Of 2024 (So Far)
summary: This article covers the 10 biggest Nvidia news stories of 2024 to date, highlighting the company's rapid expansion and continued dominance in AI computing. Key developments include strategic software startup acquisitions, plans for new GPU and CPU architectures, and significant financial achievements like surpassing Intel in annual revenue and briefly becoming the world's most valuable company. Nvidia's focus on a "full-stack" computing approach, encompassing hardware, software, and services, underpins its success amidst growing competition.

title: Meta's $10 Billion AI Hub Highlights The Louisiana Expansion
summary: Meta is investing $10 billion in a new AI-focused data center in Louisiana, its largest such initiative, aimed at boosting AI capabilities and managing extensive data. This project aligns with Meta's sustainability goals by incorporating nuclear and renewable energy sources, mirroring a broader trend among tech giants like Amazon and Microsoft. The development highlights opportunities for energy providers and could influence future collaborations between the tech and energy sectors towards sustainable digital infrastructure.

title: Insight Buys ServiceNow All-Star Partner Infocenter; Bill McDermott Weighs In
summary: Insight Enterprises has acquired Infocenter, a top ServiceNow partner, to enhance its ServiceNow consulting and managed services capabilities and boost its automation portfolio. The acquisition aims to deliver AI-fueled intelligent workflow automation solutions and leverage Infocenter's expertise in various industries. ServiceNow CEO Bill McDermott endorsed the acquisition, highlighting its strategic importance for accelerating business transformation.

title: Inseego Announces Industry’s First FIPS 140-2 Certified 5G Mobile Hotspot, MiFi® X PRO
summary: Inseego announced that its MiFi® X PRO 5G mobile hotspot is the industry's first FIPS 140-2 certified 5G mobile hotspot, providing enhanced security for government agencies and businesses. This certification means the device meets federal standards for cryptographic software, crucial for protecting sensitive data for entities like the DoD, financial institutions, and healthcare providers. Existing MiFi X PRO 5G customers will receive the FIPS 140-2 certification automatically via an over-the-air software update.

title: Nvidia dethroned as world's most valuable company after just a few days on top
summary: Nvidia's reign as the world's most valuable company was short-lived, with a two-day selloff erasing over $220 billion from its market capitalization and pushing it to third place behind Apple and Microsoft. Despite a 6.7% drop, analysts see no fundamental issues and expect any volatility to be temporary, reiterating "buy" ratings and raising price targets due to confidence in its AI leadership. The decline also coincided with broader market turbulence from a "triple-witching" options expiration.

title: Transformation from Software to Data: A Legal Perspective | Bill Reagon
summary: This article discusses Autodesk's shift from software to data, highlighting the legal challenges and priorities surrounding data privacy and security in a cloud-enabled world. title: Elastic Announces AI Ecosystem to Accelerate GenAI Application Development
summary: Elastic (NYSE: ESTC) has launched its AI Ecosystem to expedite the development and deployment of Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) applications for enterprises. This ecosystem integrates the Elasticsearch vector database with a curated selection of industry-leading AI technologies and tools. It aims to streamline the development process and improve the accuracy of GenAI applications by offering developers pre-built integrations for various critical components.

title: Goldman Sachs top strategist: We’re on the precipice of a summer correction
summary: Goldman Sachs's tactical strategist Scott Rubner warns of an impending summer correction for the S&P 500, citing historical data indicating a downturn typically begins around July 17th, followed by weak August outflows. He believes the "pain trade is no longer higher" as good news is already priced in, and systematic funds have reached maximum length. Rubner recommends put options on the Nasdaq 100 and S&P 500 to clients.

summary: Intelisys, a ScanSource company, is launching Channel Exchange, a new cloud software and platform division formerly known as intY US. This platform aims to provide partners with a streamlined sales process and a comprehensive catalog of SaaS technology solutions, complete with specialist support and advanced features like automated quoting and subscription management. Channel Exchange is designed to help partners diversify their offerings, accelerate procurement, and meet evolving customer needs.

title: SoundHound AI Reports Record Third Quarter Revenue, Up 89%, Exceeding $25 Million; Raises Outlook
summary: SoundHound AI reported record third-quarter revenue of $25.1 million, an 89% increase year-over-year, and exceeded expectations. The company also announced an increased revenue outlook for both 2024 and 2025, driven by significant diversification in customer base and expansion into new verticals like financial services, healthcare, and insurance. Keyvan Mohajer, CEO of SoundHound AI, highlighted the company's strong position in conversational AI, attributing success to strong technology, vertical integrations, and proprietary software.

title: AT&T says its network is now clear after Salt Typhoon hack
summary: AT&T confirmed that its networks are clear following an intrusion by the China-linked "Salt Typhoon" hacking operation, which sought foreign intelligence information. The company is cooperating with authorities and notifying individuals whose data may have been compromised, emphasizing that nation-state actors are no longer active in its systems. This incident is part of a broader breach affecting nine telecom companies, including Verizon and T-Mobile, with US officials still assessing the full extent of the threat.

title: Why Takeda no longer has an 'IT department' as part of the drug maker's digital and data transformation
summary: Takeda Pharmaceutical, under Chief Data and Technology Officer Gabriele Ricci, has eliminated the term "IT department" to emphasize technology as a core business function. The company has substantially reorganized its technology division, bringing most technical work in-house by hiring thousands of engineers and data scientists, and investing heavily in digital and AI transformation to adapt to a volatile pharmaceutical environment. Takeda is actively upskilling its workforce in new technologies, including generative AI tools like "myAibou," and is building and buying AI models while ensuring ethical AI practices.

summary: Corning, a 173-year-old glass-making company, is playing a crucial role in the AI revolution by producing next-generation fiber optic cables that power data centers for tech giants. Under CEO Wendell Weeks, the company has seen its market cap reach $41 billion and 2023 revenue hit $13 billion, with optical fiber now contributing 30% of its revenue. Weeks' leadership and innovative approach, admired by figures like Jeff Bezos and Jony Ive, are key to Corning's success in this evolving technological landscape.

By deploying C3 AI Reliability, the company achieved predictive monitoring capabilities, extended furnace run lengths, and expects over $45 million in annual economic benefit by scaling the solution. The project involved unifying data from multiple systems, developing machine learning models for failure prediction and coking rate forecasting, and training personnel to utilize the new application.

This controversy highlights increasing tension between progressive antitrust enforcement and some prominent business figures and donors.

title: How Boston Scientific's digital and IT boss upgraded her team from order takers to strategic thinkers
summary: Jodi Eddy, Boston Scientific's SVP and chief information and digital officer, transformed her IT team from order-takers to strategic thinkers, enabling technology to address complex healthcare systems. Eddy implemented a digital leader on every executive management board and oversaw the development of a new e-commerce site. The article also discusses Boston Scientific's cautious exploration of generative AI for internal use, while highlighting its focus on supporting human decision-making rather than replacing it.

This acquisition aims to combine Yext's digital presence platform with Hearsay's compliant engagement solutions, creating a single digital marketing platform for multi-location brands, especially in financial services. The transaction is expected to close in the second half of Yext's fiscal year 2025.

summary: Amazon's shares are lagging behind its megacap peers due to its substantial spending on artificial intelligence computing, which is impacting its profits. Investors are concerned that increased capital spending will negatively affect cash flows, especially as the company has historically performed better when focused on profitability. This shift to investment mode, coupled with Amazon's lack of a dividend and less aggressive share buyback program compared to competitors, is causing investors to pause on the stock.

title: Iron Mountain Transforms the Information Experience With New Digital Experience Platform
summary: Iron Mountain announced the launch of its InSight Digital Experience Platform (DXP), a secure SaaS platform designed to manage and monetize physical and digital information. This AI-powered platform helps customers automate workflows, ensure compliance, and turn unstructured data into actionable insights for AI initiatives. summary: VSee Health has partnered with Tele911 to create a virtual emergency department aimed at addressing ER overcrowding and EMS staffing challenges. This collaboration leverages VSee Health's telehealth platform to expand Tele911's successful model of diverting low-acuity 911 calls to telemedicine consultations, which has already saved millions in healthcare costs. summary: Coursera, in partnership with Microsoft, announced four new entry-level Professional Certificates designed to prepare learners for high-demand jobs in IT, cloud support, business analysis, and project management. summary: IBM has reportedly hit its highest stock price since 2013, nearing an all-time high, driven by investor optimism in its AI and cloud investments. summary: The 2024 Drucker Institute Company Rankings identify the 30 best-managed U.S. companies based on corporate effectiveness across five categories: customer satisfaction, financial strength, social responsibility, innovation, and employee engagement. Apple secured the top spot as the best-managed company with an effectiveness score of 92.1, surpassing Microsoft from its 2023 position. Nvidia and Microsoft followed, with Intel and MasterCard rounding out the top five, demonstrating the importance of innovation and financial strength for high effectiveness scores.

title: Wall Street declares war on the Associated Press
summary: Gannett and Reuters have partnered to provide news content, challenging the long-standing cooperative model of the Associated Press. title: How Akamai regained control of its runaway cloud bills
summary: Akamai, a technology company, significantly reduced its cloud spending by 40% in the first year of "Project Cirrus" after realizing its cloud bills had ballooned to hundreds of millions due to organic growth and acquisitions. The project involved repatriating some workloads to Akamai's acquired Linode cloud platform, reconfiguring others, and addressing inefficiencies like overprovisioning and a lack of oversight. Akamai's CIO, Kate Prouty, emphasized the importance of a strategic overhaul, educating engineers on cost stewardship, and making more deliberate choices for cloud workloads based on business outcomes.

summary: HP Inc. unveiled a new lineup of AI-powered PCs at CES 2025, winning three innovation awards for devices like the Omnibook Ultra Flip and its embedded AI Companion. The availability of these new systems is set to begin in January and February 2025, with further releases planned for the first half of the year.

summary: SK Group announced its participation in CES 2025 with an exhibition themed "Innovative AI, Sustainable Tomorrow," aiming to showcase its advanced AI technologies and services. The exhibition will feature AI data centers, AI services, and an AI ecosystem, jointly operated by four SK affiliates, to demonstrate their vision for AI business.

Major PC manufacturers like Dell Technologies Inc. and Lenovo Group Ltd. are expected to release laptops using this new technology in early 2025.

title: Ambiq and ThinkAR Disrupt the AR Glasses Industry with the AiLens
summary: Ambiq and ThinkAR have partnered to launch AiLens, a lightweight pair of smart AR glasses designed for everyday wear. These glasses weigh only 37 grams, offer over 10 hours of battery life, and are powered by Ambiq's ultra-efficient Apollo4 System-on-Chip (SoC) and ThinkAR's advanced AI capabilities. AiLens aims to redefine the AR glasses market with features like an AI-powered personal assistant, real-time language translation, and seamless integration with various platforms.

summary: Baidu, often referred to as the "Google of China," is rapidly transforming into an AI powerhouse, with its ERNIE Bot and Apollo autonomous driving platform gaining significant traction. Despite a challenging macroeconomic environment impacting its online marketing revenue, Baidu is heavily investing in AI, reporting strong growth in AI Cloud revenue and high user engagement with its generative AI content. summary: Visual media behemoths Getty Images Holdings Inc. and Shutterstock Inc. have declared their intention to merge, forming a single visual content company valued at approximately $3.7 billion. The combined entity will operate under the Getty Images name, integrating the extensive portfolios of both firms, and its shares will continue to trade on the New York Stock Exchange as "GETY". summary: Researchers analyzed leaked chat logs from the Black Basta ransomware gang, identifying 62 unique CVEs, predominantly in widely adopted enterprise technologies like Microsoft products, Citrix Netscaler, and Atlassian Confluence. The findings highlight Black Basta's preference for known vulnerabilities with publicly available exploits and their strategy of targeting high-revenue companies in legal, financial, healthcare, and industrial sectors. This underscores the critical importance of prompt patching and mitigations for widely used applications and devices.

title: Web DDoS attacks soar 550% in 2024 as cyber threats intensify, report finds
summary: Web distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks surged by 550% in 2024, driven by geopolitical conflicts, complex digital infrastructure, and AI-driven tools, according to Radware's 2025 Global Threat Analysis Report. Hacktivist activity, particularly in EMEA, fueled a significant rise in both network and application-layer DDoS incidents, with telecommunications and finance among the hardest-hit sectors. The report also highlighted a substantial increase in politically motivated cyberattacks and web application/API vulnerabilities exploited by criminal groups.

title: Veeva Adds Direct Data API to Veeva Vault Platform
summary: Veeva has launched a new Direct Data API for its Veeva Vault Platform, offering access to Vault data up to 100 times faster than traditional APIs without additional licensing fees. This API aims to facilitate AI applications, analytics, and system integrations through reliable, high-speed extraction of large datasets, with future connectors planned for major data platforms.

title: NetApp misses Q3 expectations as deal slippage hits sales
summary: NetApp reported disappointing Q3 FY2025 results, missing revenue targets with a modest 2 percent year-over-year rise to $1.64 billion, attributed largely to deal slippage late in the quarter. The company anticipates a rebound in Q4, but analysts maintain a cautious outlook.

title: PR News | Edelman Posts 4.9% '24 Revenue Dip - Fri., Feb. 28, 2025
summary: Edelman, the world's largest PR firm, reported a 4.9% revenue decrease in 2024, totaling $986 million, primarily due to weak performances in the US and APAC regions. summary: Alphabet Inc. director Frances Arnold sold 121 shares of the company's Class C Capital Stock for a total of $20,606 on February 28, 2025, as part of a pre-arranged trading plan. summary: Intapp has announced significant enhancements to its Time, Walls, and Assist products, focusing on AI-driven improvements for professional services firms. summary: This article analyzes the contrasting visions of Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella and Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff regarding the future of enterprise software and agentic AI. Nadella predicts that AI-powered agents will redefine enterprise software by largely replacing traditional SaaS applications, while Benioff believes AI will augment existing platforms. title: Koninklijke Philips N.V. (PHG) Unveils AI-Powered SmartSpeed Precise to Revolutionize MRI Imaging
summary: Koninklijke Philips N.V. (PHG) launched SmartSpeed Precise, an AI-powered MRI technology that accelerates image scanning by up to three times and improves image sharpness by 80%. summary: The global integrated facility management (IFM) market is projected to reach USD 345.70 billion by 2034, growing from USD 175.84 billion in 2025 at a CAGR of 7.10%. title: First Class Action Filed Under Washington’s MY Health MY Data Act Draws Parallels to Previous SDK Litigation
summary: The first class action lawsuit under Washington's MY Health MY Data Act (MHMDA) has been filed against Amazon, alleging improper collection and use of consumer location data via Software Development Kits (SDKs). summary: A South Korean telecommunications firm has partnered with Microsoft to establish an AI center. summary: Yale alumni have elected Jaime Teevan ’98, Microsoft’s chief scientist and GPT-4 integrator, to a six-year term on the Yale Corporation as an alumni fellow. University President Maurie McInnis highlighted Teevan’s leadership in artificial intelligence, her extensive tech expertise, and her long-standing commitment to Yale. Teevan, who was recognized by Time magazine as one of the 100 most influential people in AI in 2023, will bring her insights into technological change and AI education to the university's governing body.

title: Commvault attack may put SaaS companies across the world at risk, CISA warns
summary: The US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has issued a warning that a recent breach at Commvault could jeopardize numerous Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) providers globally. Nation-state hackers are reportedly exploiting a Commvault zero-day vulnerability (CVE-2025-3928) in Commvault Web Server to target SaaS companies, potentially gaining unauthorized access to Commvault customers' Microsoft 365 environments. CISA has added this flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog and is urging immediate patching and implementation of specified mitigations.

title: CISA Warns of Attacks Targeting Commvault SaaS Environment
summary: CISA has issued a warning regarding attacks targeting Commvault's Metallic SaaS service, where a threat actor gained unauthorized access to a small number of customers' Microsoft 365 environments. The attacks exploited a zero-day vulnerability (CVE-2025-3928) in Commvault's webserver and are believed to be part of a broader campaign targeting cloud application configurations. Organizations using Metallic are advised to prioritize protecting M365 credentials managed within the service and implement mitigation measures.

title: Threat Actors Deploy Fake DocuSign Notifications to Harvest Corporate Data
summary: Cybercriminals are increasingly using fake DocuSign notifications to conduct sophisticated phishing attacks, targeting its vast user base. These campaigns aim to harvest corporate data by directing victims to credential-harvesting sites, often exploiting human vulnerabilities and bypassing security controls through methods like QR code phishing. The article emphasizes the need for enhanced phishing awareness training, multi-factor authentication, robust security solutions, and rapid incident response to combat these evolving threats.

summary: CarMax has embarked on a significant data infrastructure modernization journey to enable its adoption of generative AI. summary: The global Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) market is projected to reach USD 415.20 billion by 2034, growing from USD 161.79 billion in 2025 at a CAGR of 11.04%. This initiative would involve News Corp's US property portal, Realtor.com, indicating a joint focus on the real estate sector. The talks were revealed by News Corp CEO Robert Thomson at an investor conference, highlighting the early stages of this collaborative effort.

title: Vistra Corp’s Multibillion Makeover: Boom or Bubble?
summary: Vistra Corp. (VST) is experiencing significant stock growth driven by strategic mergers, potential acquisitions like Comanche Peak, and legislative support from the Texas SB6 bill. Analysts from Jefferies, BMO Capital, and Melius Research have raised price targets, reflecting optimism about the company's performance, renewable energy initiatives, and the transformative impact of AI in the power sector. Despite high debt metrics, Vistra's strategic financial management and focus on sustainable solutions are positioning it for long-term growth and resilience.

title: How Matt Damon's WaterEquity Powers Sustainable Energy
summary: Matt Damon's WaterEquity has launched its Water & Climate Resilience Fund with an initial US$5 million investment in Savant Group, aiming to bridge water access gaps, bolster resilience, and generate long-term sustainable value in the energy sector. The fund, which has secured over US$100 million in commitments from investors like Microsoft, Starbucks, and Xylem, focuses on financing climate-resilient water and sanitation infrastructure, including solar-powered water pumps. This initiative is set to provide safe water and sanitation to 15 million people across Africa, Asia, and Latin America, addressing climate change, gender equality, and health outcomes.

title: Press Release: Gartner Hype Cycle for AI in Finance Identifies Three Near-Term Focus Areas for CFOs
summary: Gartner's Hype Cycle for AI in Finance identifies three key areas for CFOs to focus on in the near term: Generative AI, Composite AI, and Responsible AI. These technologies are anticipated to have a transformational impact and reach mainstream adoption within two years, helping finance leaders navigate the evolving landscape of AI. The report highlights the increasing integration of GenAI in enterprise applications and the importance of combining AI techniques for broader problem-solving, alongside the critical need for ethical and compliant AI development.

title: NVIDIA Enters the Quantum Computing Field: A New Era of Tech Innovation
summary: NVIDIA has officially entered the quantum computing field with an investment by its venture capital arm in Quantinuum, a company valued at $10 billion. This strategic move follows CEO Jensen Huang's shift from skepticism to strong support for quantum computing, highlighted by the launch of NVIDIA’s open-source quantum development platform, CUDA-Q, which aims to integrate quantum and classical high-performance computing. The article discusses the accelerating investment and development in quantum computing by other major tech players and governments, signaling a global race for technological supremacy in this transformative field.

title: Oracle salta 36%, “ganha” US$ 244 bi e tem melhor sessão de 1992 com ânimo sobre IA
summary: Oracle's shares soared 36%, adding US$244 billion to its market value and marking its best session since 1992, driven by an aggressive outlook for its cloud business and strong demand for AI infrastructure. The company is emerging as a key provider of computational capacity for AI, signing massive contracts including a commitment with OpenAI for 4.5 gigawatts of data center capacity. Oracle's CEO, Safra Catz, projects significant growth in its cloud infrastructure unit, despite high investment costs in data centers.

title: Institutional investors have a lot riding on Rimini Street, Inc. (NASDAQ:RMNI) with 34% ownership
summary: Institutional investors hold a significant 34% ownership in Rimini Street, Inc. (NASDAQ:RMNI), making the stock sensitive to their trading actions. The top four shareholders control 51% of the business, with private equity firms holding another 25%, indicating strong influence from a concentrated group of owners. Insiders have recently sold shares, though they still hold a substantial stake, suggesting varied sentiment within different ownership segments.

title: ScanSource Exec: ‘The Age Of Convergence Is Truly Upon Us’
summary: ScanSource's Specialty Technologies business president, Tony Sorrentino, urged partners to embrace "convergence" by moving beyond hardware sales to focus on integrated solutions that combine hardware, software, and services. He emphasized that this shift will increase partners' value to customers, wallet share, and margins by addressing customer demands for outcomes rather than siloed technologies. Sorrentino outlined six megatrends driving this convergence, including hardware, cloud/subscription, connectivity, cybersecurity/AI, digitization/automation, and channel enablement.

title: Hudson RPO becomes Hudson Talent Solutions
summary: Star Equity Holdings announced that its subsidiary, Hudson RPO, has rebranded as Hudson Talent Solutions. This change reflects the company's broader offerings beyond RPO, positioning itself as a global talent partner providing data-driven solutions across the entire talent lifecycle, including RPO, talent advisory, executive search, talent intelligence, and MSP. The rebrand includes a new website, hudsontalent.com, reinforcing its strengthened global brand identity.

title: Data Security Posture Management Market Size, Share and Forecast 2025-2034
summary: The Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) market is projected to grow at a 34.2% CAGR from 2025 to 2034, driven by the increasing adoption of cloud computing, AI, and stringent regulatory mandates. DSPM solutions help organizations safeguard sensitive data by identifying and remediating risks across diverse and complex data environments. North America currently leads this market due to rising cybersecurity concerns and robust adoption of cloud services, while the BFSI sector shows the highest growth among end-use applications.

title: Lunate Capital lines up quantum computing ETF
summary: Lunate Capital is launching the Boreas Solactive Quantum Computing UCITS ETF (QUANTM) to expand its Irish-domiciled ETF offerings. This new ETF, listing on the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange on September 22nd with a 0.49% TER, will track 25 companies in quantum computing hardware, software, algorithms, and communication. The firm sometimes opts for UCITS ETFs over Sharia-compliant ones to avoid filtering out major, marketable companies.

title: Reimagining how we collaborate with Microsoft Teams and AI agents - Inside Track Blog
summary: This article from Microsoft's Inside Track blog discusses how the company is reimagining collaboration through Microsoft Teams and AI agents. It highlights the evolution from traditional collaborative tools to AI-powered experiences like Microsoft Loop, Pages, and Copilot Studio, which enhance productivity and integrate AI deeply into daily workflows. The article showcases various AI applications within Microsoft, from guiding meetings and summarizing information to automating tasks and democratizing knowledge sharing with tools like Agent Builder in SharePoint.

title: OpenAI Takes Big Steps Toward Its Long-Planned Reorganization
summary: OpenAI has announced a tentative deal with Microsoft and a plan to give a $100 billion equity stake to its controlling nonprofit, moving toward its reorganization into a public benefit corporation. These steps address financial complexities with Microsoft, which had invested over $13 billion, and come amidst increasing pressure from regulators and experts concerned about OpenAI's focus. The agreement includes renegotiated financial terms and technology sharing between the two companies.

title: A joint statement from Microsoft and OpenAI
summary: Microsoft and OpenAI have signed a non-binding memorandum of understanding for the next phase of their partnership. They are working to finalize a definitive agreement. Both companies remain focused on delivering AI tools with a shared commitment to safety.

title: Vanguard’s VUG ETF: The Ultimate Growth ETF for Your Portfolio
summary: The article highlights the Vanguard Growth ETF (VUG) as a top choice for investors seeking exposure to large-cap growth stocks, particularly those benefiting from innovation and AI. VUG's strong performance, low expense ratio, and strategic holdings in tech giants like NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Apple make it an attractive option. The fund offers broad diversification compared to individual stock picking, positioning it as a core holding for long-term growth-oriented portfolios.

title: Teledyne To Buy TransponderTech From Saab
summary: Teledyne Technologies Incorporated (NYSE: TDY) announced its acquisition of TransponderTech from Saab AB to expand its maritime solutions. TransponderTech, a leader in AIS, VDES, and GNSS technologies, will integrate into Teledyne FLIR’s Maritime division. This move, expected to close in Q4 2025, aims to enhance maritime safety, efficiency, and operational reach by broadening Teledyne's technological footprint in navigation and security.

title: Global Enterprises Embrace Adobe and its AI Innovations to Power Growth
summary: Adobe announced that global enterprises are rapidly adopting its AI innovations, with 99% of Fortune 100 companies utilizing AI in an Adobe app and nearly 90% of its top 50 enterprise accounts adopting AI-first solutions. This adoption has led to significant efficiencies and increased annualized recurring revenue for many of these companies, highlighting AI's role in scaling content, accelerating decision-making, and enhancing customer experiences. Major brands like IBM, ServiceNow, and The Coca-Cola Company are leveraging Adobe's AI-powered offerings to streamline workflows and boost creative output.

title: Online Media Brands Hope a New Protocol Will Stop Unwanted AI Crawlers
summary: Online media brands, including major publishers like Yahoo, Quora, Medium, and Ziff Davis (CNET's parent company), are implementing a new protocol called RSL (Really Simple Licensing) to prevent AI companies from using their content for model training without permission or compensation. RSL is designed to be a more robust technical layer than robots.txt for managing AI crawlers, which now constitute over half of internet traffic. The initiative aims to ensure content creators are fairly compensated, especially as publishers are seeing significant traffic reductions due to AI-generated answers and chatbots.

title: iShares MSCI World ETF: Rekordlauf dank Tech-Giganten
summary: The iShares MSCI World ETF is experiencing a record run, largely driven by the strong performance of American technology giants like NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Apple, which constitute a significant portion (14.41%) of its portfolio. Despite this concentration, the ETF maintains broad diversification across 1,321 individual titles and boasts a 14.45% annual performance with minimal tracking error. Investors are showing growing confidence, with the fund attracting over 891 million dollars in inflows over the past year.

title: Huntington Bank's plan to obtain a return on gen AI
summary: Huntington Bank is focusing on generating a measurable return on its generative AI investments, targeting 10-15% in cost reductions and revenue increases. CFO Zach Wasserman emphasized balancing the urgency of AI adoption with ensuring ROI and usability, contrasting with a report stating 95% of businesses see zero return on gen AI. The bank is deploying AI across various use cases, including software development, streamlining internal processes, general employee productivity, and personalization, with agentic AI expected to further automate multi-person tasks.

title: Galaxy's Novogratz calls it the 'season of SOL', says Solana is tailor made for financial markets
summary: Galaxy Digital CEO Mike Novogratz announced the "season of SOL," stating that Solana is optimally designed for financial markets due to its speed and transaction capacity. He highlighted strong market momentum and shifting regulatory landscapes, with SEC Chair Paul Atkins advocating for markets to move onchain. Novogratz believes these factors, combined with increasing institutional adoption and clarity, are paving the way for Wall Street to embrace blockchain technology, particularly Solana.

title: Synopsys Stock Soars: Is It Still a Buy?
summary: Synopsys Inc. (NASDAQ: SNPS) stock increased by 12.98% following advancements in AI design solutions and an acquisition of Ansys. The company reported $1.74 billion in Q3 revenue, a 14% increase year over year, although EPS fell to $1.50 from $2.73. Despite some mixed analyst ratings and recent stock volatility, Synopsys maintains strong profitability and liquidity, with strategic investments in AI and educational initiatives bolstering its long-term outlook.

title: Vanguard's VUG ETF: The Ultimate Growth ETF for Your Portfolio
summary: The Vanguard Growth ETF (VUG) is highlighted as a premier investment for growth-oriented portfolios, driven by its focus on large-cap companies at the forefront of innovation, particularly in AI and technology. The article details its top holdings like NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Apple, its consistent outperformance against benchmarks such as the S&P 500, and its exceptionally low expense ratio. VUG is presented as a stable, diversified, and cost-effective vehicle for long-term wealth building, offering broad exposure to dynamic companies shaping the global economy.

title: Blink Charging joins Paua
summary: Blink Charging has partnered with Paua, integrating its network of 850 public charging locations and approximately 3,500 connectors into Paua's platform. This collaboration expands Paua's network to over 67,000 EV charger connectors, aiming to provide a more accessible and seamless charging experience for EV drivers, particularly for fleets in the UK. The partnership emphasizes making reliable, renewable energy more readily available for businesses transitioning to electric transport.

title: Lai outlines four key aspects of Taiwan’s national security resilience
summary: President William Lai outlined four key aspects of Taiwan's national security resilience at a forum: supply chain security, digital communications, whole-of-society defense, and the economy. He emphasized the need to improve supply chain resilience due to geopolitical tensions, promote multi-layered digital communication networks, and build resilience through citizen participation. Economic resilience initiatives include assisting SMEs and encouraging financial institutions to support businesses during challenging times.

title: 4 AI stocks to watch, according to fund manager crushing the S&P 500
summary: Denny Fish, co-manager of the Janus Henderson Global Technology and Innovation Fund, which has significantly outperformed the S&P 500, shares his top AI stock picks. While his fund's largest holdings include Nvidia, Microsoft, Taiwan Semiconductor, and Broadcom, he highlights four specific companies he's most bullish on now for continued growth in the AI sector. These include Taiwan Semiconductor, Cadence, KLA, and Mercado Libre, emphasizing their strong market positions and AI integration.

title: CHROs should take a more active role in digital security, Gartner advises
summary: Gartner advises Chief Human Resources Officers (CHROs) to adopt a more active stance in digital security, especially with the integration of AI and automation in HR functions. The report outlines four key steps: making security a core part of HR automation, proactively identifying threats, establishing third-party risk management for HR tools, and fostering a strong security culture within the organization. This proactive approach is crucial to prevent data breaches, protect intellectual property, and maintain employee trust in an increasingly digital HR landscape.

title: Rezolve Ai Launches Visual Search, Replacing Keyword Search with Conversational Commerce
summary: Rezolve AI (NASDAQ: RZLV) has launched Visual Search, a new feature allowing consumers to use their phone cameras to search a retailer's catalog, replacing traditional keyword searches with "Conversational Commerce." This technology, powered by Rezolve's proprietary vision models and generative AI, enables users to point their camera at an item to find matching or similar products, bridging the gap between inspiration and purchase. The company highlights that this system provides more precise results and faster processing than conventional search methods, offering a seamless journey from visual discovery to personalized recommendations and one-tap checkout.

title: What's Going On With IonQ Stock Today?
summary: IonQ, Inc. (NYSE: IONQ) announced that it has received regulatory approval from the United Kingdom's Investment Security Unit for its acquisition of Oxford Ionics, fulfilling all deal conditions. The company also launched IonQ Federal to specifically address the U.S. government and allied partners' quantum computing and networking needs, having already secured over $100 million in government contracts. IONQ stock has surged over 537% in the past year, trading higher by 15.71% to $54.32 at the time of reporting.

title: Amazon's Relentless Drive Higher Raises The Stakes For Direxion's AMZU, AMZD ETFs
summary: Amazon has shown resilient performance despite broader tech sector volatility, driven by initiatives like Project Kuiper in the satellite internet market. However, some recent indicators, such as a slowdown in AWS growth and a decline in Prime membership sign-ups, suggest potential challenges. These mixed signals create a dynamic environment for Direxion's leveraged ETFs, AMZU (bullish) and AMZD (bearish), which allow investors to bet on Amazon's daily performance, though with inherent risks like value decay.

title: MOGU Stock Jumps 155% After Announcing $20 Million Crypto Investment Plan
summary: Chinese fashion company MOGU saw its stock surge by over 155% in pre-market trading after announcing a $20 million investment plan in cryptocurrencies. The company's board approved the strategy to purchase Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana for treasury diversification and to prepare for AI integration. This move reflects a growing trend among corporations to adopt digital assets, significantly boosting MOGU's stock performance and trading volume.

title: CIBC CIO Richard Jardim On Building A Bank For The Modern World
summary: Richard Jardim, CIO of CIBC, discusses his dual mandate of embedding CIOs into business lines and driving enterprise-wide initiatives like cloud migration. He emphasizes simplifying complex processes, investing in people through programs like an internal generative AI platform, and focusing on client value. Jardim also highlights the bank's strategic approach to emerging technologies like AI and quantum computing.

title: Penguin Ai Snags $30M to Simplify Prior Auth, Coding and Claims
summary: Penguin Ai, a Palo Alto-based startup, secured $29.7 million in funding led by Greycroft, to simplify prior authorization, medical coding, and claims processing. The company aims to tackle the trillion-dollar problem of healthcare administration by offering a comprehensive AI platform that automates and streamlines these workflows for both payers and providers. Founded by Fawad Butt, formerly of Optum and UnitedHealthcare, Penguin Ai distinguishes itself from point solutions by building a holistic "Epic of the healthcare back office."

title: Insights From Our New Evaluation, The Forrester Wave™: Digital Analytics Solutions, Q3 2025
summary: This article announces the release of "The Forrester Wave™: Digital Analytics Solutions, Q3 2025" report, which evaluates the evolving digital analytics solutions market. It highlights key trends such as the need for multiple tools for holistic insights, the varying depth of Generative AI capabilities among vendors, and the critical importance of data integration for actionable insights across enterprise systems. The report analyzes 10 top vendors based on 30 criteria for current offerings and seven for strategy.

title: iShares MSCI World ETF: KI-Boom treibt Rekordjagd
summary: The iShares MSCI World ETF is experiencing a record hunt driven by the AI boom, primarily due to its strong focus on US technology stocks like NVIDIA and Microsoft. While this concentration has led to outstanding performance, it also carries significant risks due to high dependency on a few mega-cap companies. The article questions the sustainability of this strategy given valuation concerns and the influence of interest rate expectations on investor risk appetite.

title: Ohio regulators turn down appeal, OK utility’s data center billing plan
summary: Ohio's Public Utilities Commission (PUCO) has approved American Electric Power's (AEP) plan to charge data centers differently for electricity, acknowledging the strain these large consumers place on the grid. This decision, despite appeals from major tech companies and the Ohio Manufacturers Association, sets specific tariffs for data centers and aims to ensure they bear the cost of their infrastructure demands. Some affected parties, like the Ohio Manufacturers Association, plan to appeal the ruling to the state Supreme Court.

title: Box (BOX): Evaluating Valuation After Major AI-Powered Product Launches in Secure Content and Workflow Automation
summary: Box (NYSE:BOX) recently launched AI-powered products like Box Shield Pro and Box Automate, signaling a shift towards AI and automation in its growth strategy. Despite recent stock volatility and a dip in net income, analysts view Box as undervalued, suggesting future growth prospects from these new offerings and partnerships with major AI and enterprise software providers. The article explores different valuation perspectives, including a DCF model, which also indicates potential undervaluation.

title: Microsoft announces quarterly dividend increase
summary: Microsoft announced a quarterly dividend increase to $0.91 per share, marking an 8-cent or 10% rise from the previous quarter. The company also set the date for its 2025 Annual Shareholders Meeting for December 5, 2025, which will be held virtually. Key executives, including Satya Nadella and Amy Hood, will host the meeting.

title: Alphabet enters $3 trillion market cap club as Big Tech's AI momentum builds
summary: Google parent Alphabet achieved a $3 trillion market capitalization for the first time, driven by renewed optimism in artificial intelligence and a favorable antitrust ruling. Its shares have rallied over 32% this year, making it the best performer among the "Magnificent 7" stocks. This milestone positions Alphabet alongside Apple and Microsoft in the $3 trillion club, with a recent court ruling allowing it to retain control of its Chrome browser and Android operating system.

title: Popular’s Luis Montalvo on how a ‘digital teammate’ is transforming the workplace
summary: Luis Montalvo, Assistant Vice President and Digital Workplace Manager at Popular Inc., highlights how Microsoft 365 Copilot has become an essential tool, transforming his daily workflow, from reviewing contracts to drafting emails. Copilot has significantly increased productivity and agility within the organization, leading to widespread adoption among over 1,000 active users. Montalvo champions its use across Popular Inc., initiating "Copilot-thon" events to train employees and interns, demonstrating its impact on tasks from project management to marketing.

title: Nebius Group announces closings of its public offering of Class A ordinary shares and concurrent private offering of convertible senior notes, with aggregate gross proceeds to date of approximately $4.2 billion
summary: Nebius Group announced the closing of its public offering of 10,810,811 Class A ordinary shares at $92.50 per share, and a concurrent private offering of convertible senior notes, totaling approximately $4.2 billion in aggregate gross proceeds. The funding is intended to finance the company's growth, including acquiring additional compute power and hardware, expanding data centers, and general corporate purposes, partially supporting its AI infrastructure agreement with Microsoft. Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC led the share offering, with Morgan Stanley, BofA Securities, and Citigroup as additional book-running managers.

title: The Procter & Gamble Company (PG) Focused on Innovation and Efficiency to Accelerate Growth
summary: The Procter & Gamble Company (NYSE: PG) is focusing on innovation and efficiency to drive future growth, as reiterated at the Barclays 18th Annual Global Consumer Staples Conference 2025. The company plans organizational restructuring, optimizing value chains, and improving productivity through technology. It also anticipates mid-to-single-digit price increases on 25% of its U.S. portfolio due to tariff headwinds, positioning itself as a strong defensive stock according to Steve Cohen.

title: BlackRock transforms $3 billion in active funds into ETFs to feed model portfolio engine
summary: BlackRock has converted two $3 billion mutual funds into ETFs (BDYN and BDVL) to better integrate them into its rapidly growing model portfolio engine, Global Allocation Selects. This strategic move aims to meet client demand for active ETFs within these portfolios and streamlines the firm's asset management. Additionally, BlackRock is investing £500 million into UK data centers and plans to allocate a total of £7 billion to UK projects, coinciding with financial commitments from other American firms ahead of a US presidential visit.

title: 5 Safe, Inexpensive Ways to Invest in AI
summary: The global AI market is projected to experience significant growth, from $137 billion in 2022 to over $1.81 trillion by 2030, offering substantial investment opportunities. title: McGraw Hill stock price target raised to $25 by BMO Capital
summary: BMO Capital has increased its price target for McGraw Hill (NYSE:MH) to $25.00 from $24.00, maintaining an Outperform rating. The firm believes the stock has been unfairly impacted by AI developments despite the company's strong market position and operational efficiency, evidenced by 80% gross profit margins and expected net income growth. McGraw Hill is also making strategic advancements, including a Credit Agreement repricing and a positive outlook from Moody's following its IPO, with analysts highlighting its digital transformation and recurring revenue model.

title: Inflation IPO, D-Wave Surge, and Quantum Computing’s High-Stakes Future (2025)
summary: The quantum computing sector is volatile yet promising, with Infleqtion preparing for an IPO via SPAC, focusing on neutral-atom technology and quantum sensing. D-Wave (QBTS) has seen significant growth in 2025 due to its quantum annealing technology and strategic partnerships. Investors can gain exposure through pure-play stocks, the Defiance Quantum ETF (QTUM), or tech giants like IBM and Microsoft, balancing high risk with potential long-term returns in a still-developing industry.

title: Submit once, use everywhere: The FDTA & structured business reporting are redefining compliance
summary: The Financial Data Transparency Act (FDTA) and structured business reporting are poised to revolutionize financial compliance by shifting from static, form-based filings to machine-readable, standardized data. This transition promises greater efficiency, transparency, and strategic opportunities for regulators and industry alike, requiring significant organizational changes, technological upgrades, and skill development. Organizations are encouraged to actively engage with policymakers and vendors to prepare for this data-driven future, transforming regulatory data into a strategic asset rather than a compliance burden.

title: Microsoft Executive Named to electroCore’s Board of Directors
summary: electroCore Inc. has appointed Elena Bonfiglioli, Microsoft’s global business leader for Healthcare, Pharma Life Sciences, to its Board of Directors, succeeding Peter Cuneo. Bonfiglioli brings over two decades of experience in the health sector, with a focus on AI transformation initiatives and advocating for data-driven health solutions. Her appointment aims to strengthen electroCore's corporate governance and drive growth for its non-invasive bioelectronic technologies.

title: IWY ETF Price at $270.12: Outperformance Driven by Mega-Cap Tech
summary: The iShares Russell Top 200 Growth ETF (IWY) has climbed to $270.12, showcasing significant outperformance with a 25.34% yearly gain driven by its concentrated holdings in mega-cap tech giants like NVIDIA and Microsoft. The ETF is positioned to benefit from the AI capital expenditure supercycle and is projected to reach the $300-$310 range within the next year, despite its premium valuation. Its strategic weighting methodology balances concentration risk while leveraging strong growth prospects from its top holdings.

title: NVIDIA and United Kingdom Build Nation’s AI Infrastructure and Ecosystem to Fuel Innovation, Economic Growth and Jobs
summary: NVIDIA is collaborating with the United Kingdom to build the nation's AI infrastructure, involving partners like Nscale, CoreWeave, and Microsoft, and an investment of up to £11 billion. This initiative includes deploying hundreds of thousands of NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs, establishing AI factories, and boosting quantum computing and AI/robotics ecosystems. The goal is to accelerate the AI industrial revolution in the UK, fostering innovation, economic growth, and job creation.

title: 4 Must-Own Dividend-Growth Stocks
summary: This article highlights four dividend-growth stocks—Microsoft, Broadcom, Apple, and Visa—that are among the top holdings of two highly-rated dividend-growth funds, Vanguard Dividend Growth and T. Rowe Price Dividend Growth. These companies are characterized by strong financial health, wide economic moats, and consistent dividend increases, making them attractive for long-term investors when purchased at fair value or below.

summary: QQQ ETF (Invesco QQQ ETF) mô phỏng hiệu suất của chỉ số NASDAQ-100, bao gồm 100 công ty phi tài chính lớn nhất trên Nasdaq, chủ yếu là các công ty công nghệ hàng đầu như Apple, Microsoft, Amazon và Nvidia. title: Nebius Group Completes $4.16 Billion in Public Share and Convertible Note Offerings
summary: Nebius Group (NASDAQ: NBIS) has successfully closed public and private offerings, raising a total of $4.16 billion to fund its global AI infrastructure expansion. The financing included the sale of Class A ordinary shares and convertible senior notes. These proceeds will be used to scale AI compute capabilities, expand data center footprints, and further Nebius’s agreement with Microsoft.

summary: Bandwidth Inc. is set to livestream its annual product keynote, Reverb25, TODAY at 10:30 am EDT, focusing on new AI and trust innovations in cloud communications. The event will feature insights from Bandwidth leaders, special guests, and real-world demos, addressing critical industry imperatives. Registration is still open and provides access to the livestream, replay, and highlights.

title: Duolingo Scores Are Coming to LinkedIn. It Could Change Hiring Forever
summary: Duolingo has partnered with LinkedIn to allow users to display their Duolingo Scores on their LinkedIn profiles, providing an additional layer of verification for language proficiency beyond self-reporting. This feature aims to offer recruiters and employers a more consistent and dynamic understanding of a candidate's language abilities. The Duolingo Score aligns with the Common European Framework of Reference (CEFR) and is initially available for Spanish, French, and English, with plans for expansion.

title: Conduent Integrates AI Technologies to Modernize Government Payments, Combat Fraud and Improve Customer Experiences for Beneficiaries
summary: Conduent is integrating generative AI and other advanced AI technologies into its solutions for state and federal agencies to modernize government payments, combat fraud, and improve beneficiary experiences. A successful AI pilot with Microsoft has significantly boosted fraud detection in open-loop payment card programs, with plans to expand to Medicaid and SNAP benefits. Conduent is also using AI to enhance customer support for public benefit recipients by providing agents with instant, accurate information, thereby reducing call handling times.

title: Andrey Omelchak's Top Picks: Electrovaya, TFI International & Mattr Corp
summary: Andrey Omelchak, CEO & CIO of LionGuard Capital Management, has shared his top stock picks. His selections include Electrovaya, TFI International, and Mattr Corp. The article presents this information, along with links to other market call videos.

title: Bitfarms Stock Hits One-Year High After Six Straight Days Of Gains – Retail Chatter Hits Peak Levels
summary: Shares of Bitcoin miner Bitfarms (BITF) surged over 15% to a more than one-year high of $2.90, marking six consecutive days of gains fueled by "extremely bullish" retail sentiment and chatter on Stocktwits. The rally is attributed to Nebius Group's five-year agreement to supply Microsoft with GPUs, benefiting companies with large-scale computing power like Bitcoin miners, and Bitfarms' strategic pivot into high-performance computing and AI infrastructure. The company also reported an 87% year-over-year revenue increase in Q2 from this strategy and plans to expand its U.S. presence.

title: WIX Stock: Analyzing the Surge and Its Implications
summary: Wix.com Ltd. (NASDAQ: WIX) stock has surged by 5.83% due to promising earnings forecasts and investor enthusiasm. Key drivers include raised price targets, a $1 billion convertible senior note offering, strategic partnerships with firms like Broadridge, and growth in creative subscriptions. Despite strong revenue, the company faces challenges with negative profit margins and inefficiencies in capital utilization, requiring strategic financial steering to ensure sustained fiscal health.

title: National Grid partners with AI firm to test dynamic management of datacentre energy demands
summary: National Grid is partnering with Emerald AI to pilot a technology enabling AI datacentres to flexibly adjust their power draw from the grid, aiming to reduce the burden on UK power supplies. The Conduction platform, utilizing Nvidia GPUs, will dynamically manage energy consumption based on workload demands, especially during peak periods. This collaboration seeks to optimize existing grid capacity, attract investment in advanced computing, and support the UK's transition to a more efficient energy system, proving that AI datacentres can be an asset rather than a burden.

title: Alphabet has reached a market capitalization of $3 trillion for the first time. What does the company earn the most from?
